programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called out to the Garde Arts Center in New London, Connecticut. The Center is the former site of the Williams Family Mansion, built in1831 by Thomas Wheeler Williams. Mr. Williams was a congressman and part of the whaling community; in a city know as the "Whaling City." Thomas Wheeler Williams married twice having a total of 9 children. Tragically 5 of Thomas's children died under the age of 22yrs.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called to Cornwall Bridge, Connecticut to investigate the Vogel Residence. Their client, Robin Vogel, is afraid that the Curse Of Dudleytown has spread to her home and has asked TAPS to help. Dudleytown was an abandoned settlement that dates back to the 1740's. Many people believe the settlement was cursed due to the fact that many inhabitants died a violent death or went insane. The Vogel Residence was originally built in 1780 with an addition put on in 1830.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Wilmington, Delaware to investigate Rockwood Museum. They are joined by two of their paranormal friends: actors Rachel Nichols, and Jonathan Sadowski. The original owner of the mansion was Joseph Shipley. He was born into a wealthy family in Wilmington, but made his own money as a merchant banker in Liverpool, England. He built Rockwood Mansion in 1854 to resemble his Liverpool home, Wyncote.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: We are introduced to Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson, co-founders and lead investigators for The Atlantic Paranormal Society (TAPS). Their Technical Manager, Brian Harnois, tells them of an interesting case. The home they are to investigate is in Altoona, PA which is several hours away, but because of the dramatic nature of the case they decide to make the long drive. They investigate reports of poltergeist activity in a home with a very young girl who seems to see the spirits.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The team investigates the historic Mishler Theatre and the Altoona Railroaders Memorial Museum. At the theater, the owner and employees have seen the late owner walking into the wall where his old office used to be, sitting in the seats, and have heard him walking on the catwalk above the stage. At the museum, the spirit of a railroad worker has been seen. Despite some orb activity in the theater, neither site presents any good evidence of paranormal activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The team investigates The Lighthouse Inn in New London, Conn., which is reported to be haunted by the ghost of a bride who fell down a flight of stairs on her wedding day in 1930. Drops in temperature are recorded, and Steve feels someone touch him on his back when no one else is nearby. They then travel to Ashland, Mass. to a pub called Stone's Public House, formerly The Railroad House. Here, a little girl died after being hit by a train.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: At the request of the US Coast Guard, TAPS goes to Long Island Sound to investigate the Race Rock Lighthouse. The lighthouse is now automated, but the Coast Guard officers who come to do maintenance and inspection have reported strange occurrences and are nervous about going to the site. The commanding officers hope to disprove the rumors. The team's cameras pick up strange orb activity and a fog which the investigators do not remember from the time of the video.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS investigates Eastern State Penitentiary, an abandoned prison with a long, colorful history and a reputation for paranormal activity. While there, they capture a strange, shadowy shape on film. After reviewing the film, Jason decides that the team should return. More orbs are caught on film, but no repeat of the shadowy figure. Efforts to duplicate the footage prove unsuccessful, but Jason and Grant see how it could have been done.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This investigation focuses on some friends of Brian's whose home is a deconsecrated 19th century church. They claim to have seen apparitions and to have heard strange noises. Also, one of the doors in the house opens by itself. The investigation turns up only orbs caused by dust. Jason determines that the sounds and orbs are caused by the settling of the wood beams when the church bell rings. The team is able to duplicate the opening door, giving a mundane explanation.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called to investigate an armory in New Bedford, Mass. In one room, the thermal imaging camera detects a warm mist passing in front of the lens. This is very strange, because mists are generally colder than the surrounding air. While moving along a catwalk, sound man Frank DeAngelis suddenly falls down and does not feel well enough to move for quite some time.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Reports of disturbances in a college student group house are easily explained as acoustics and encounters with neighbors who were drunk at the time. At the Topton House Pub, witnesses have reported that the ghost of a little girl sometimes trips people on the steps and has moved glasses of soda on one table. The daughter of the owner has also smelled roses while in the cellar and heard murmurring voices.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Mike Sinclair, the founder of O.R.I.O.N. Paranormal and a TAPS family member, has called in TAPS to co-investigate the New Boston Inn, in the Berkshires. After examining his findings, the TAPS team is able to disprove or cast doubt upon, everything he found. However, the experience their own incident when a pen seems to have moved with no one else nearby. Next they travel to Pittsburgh to investigate the home of Gloria and Genny.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Cannellini pesto dip and a crudite spread; spaghetti primavera with courgette, green beans, peas and asparagus; spinach, bread and ricotta frittata.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There is a party in the air with an Italian flair. Lidia teaches the viewer several dishes that will work for any party - including a selection of varies cheese, cured meat and Giardiniera Style Vegetables; an easy and quick Sweet and Sour Zucchini Dish and lastly Stuffed Mushrooms made with a delicious mixture of scallions, red peppers and fresh parsley. Lastly there is still time for a delicious salad of poached seafood featuring shrimp, mussels and calamari.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Whether used in soups, roasted or stuffed, the Italians love their vegetables. In this episode, she makes a platter full of Roasted Peppers Stuffed with Tuna. She then creates a mellow dish of Savory Onions Stuffed with Lamb and Sweet Raisins. The Cauliflower and Tomato Soup is one that warms the heart and any kitchen table.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America
programme.desc: Join Lidia Bastianich on a deeply personal culinary journey in celebration of life's milestones, sharing in the wonderful diversity of American culture and food. Milestones include sweet sixteen, baptism, graduation, and a house blessing.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The oven is on in today's episode! With a little bit of prep time and a hot oven, you can enjoy the appetizers with the friends and family while the rest is baking. Today's recipes include: Spicy Stuffed Clams; Roasted Chicken with Pomegranate; and Potatoes Stuffed with Sausage & Mushrooms.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Grilled corn, courgette and tomato salad; spicy lobster linguine.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The tradition of kneading dough has always been around in Lidia's family. She recalls kneading with her grandmother as a small child and continues to do it with her own grandchildren today. In this episode, she prepares a buttery, flaky Crostata with Kale, Butternut Squash and Ricotta, a delicious Butternut Squash and Brussels Sprouts Panzanella using leftover bread, and finally Pappardelle with Mixed Fresh Mushrooms.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Entertaining comes in many forms, and today Lidia creates a menu that is perfect for an intimate gathering of friends and family. This simply elegant dinner menu includes Swordfish alla Bagnara, a delicately steamed swordfish made with an aromatic mix of lemon, capers and garlic - a traditional dish from the Calabrian town of Bagnara. She'll then do a spicy Bloody Mary, followed by a classic Lagane e Ceci - ribbons of fresh pasta made with chickpeas and pepperoncino.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italy is a garden year round, and Lidia celebrates an array of beautiful vegetable dishes including: Celery Stalks Stuffed with Gorgonzola and Apples; an elegant Asparagus and Scallion Salad; a refreshing Fava Sesame Dip, that pairs beautifully with flat breads and finally a Linguine with Swisschard made with walnuts and creamy fresh ricotta.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today's recipes are perfect for entertaining and include a savory Onion-Tomato Focaccia, restaurant inspired spreads for fresh bread and Skillet or Grilled Calamari.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Focaccia is an irresistible, crunchy Italian flatbread. It's great for sandwiches and even to stuff. Lidia begins by making a Classic Rosemary and Lemon Focaccia; she then moves on to a Filled Focaccia with Smoky Speck and Fontina Cheese. To finish these two lunchtime and snack favorites, she creates a Salad of Shrimp, Fava and Cranberry Beans.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Potato and pasta soup; a salad of green beans and new potatoes; ditalini with potatoes and provoke.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Surf n' Turf might not be an Italian tradition, but a Crispy Shrimp, Swordfish Skewers with Sweet and Sour Sauce go beautifully with a Maremma Style Steak! Tutti in Cucina! Everyone in the kitchen today!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The oven is on today in Lidia's Kitchen, and she is sharing some of her best cakes. There is a Gianduia Cake - a Piedmontese tradition and a dream for hazelnut and chocolate lovers; a delicious and moist Chocolate and Zucchini Cake; and finally a nutty Walnut and Espresso Cake.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia shares some of her all-time favorites - Tomato and Onion Salad alla Calabrese, a great salad to make in the summer when tomatoes are sweet and ripe. Everyone loves meatballs, and Lidia shows viewers how to use leftovers in a Leftover Meatball Panini. Finally, Lidia stuffs Pizza Rolls with broccoli rabe and sausage and with ricotta and leeks.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: As a child, Lidia's courtyard was home to several animals. She spent a lot of time with chickens, as she would tend to them and gather their eggs. In this episode, Lidia recollects those fond memories and creates a medley of vegetables, salumi, cheese and hard boiled eggs for her Chopped Salad with Frisee and Fennel. She also prepares a Chicken Cacciatore as well as a Potato and Egg Frico.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Steamed broccoli, cannellini and egg salad; skillet tuna with aubergine and courgette in puttanesca sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: First Comes Marriage, Then Comes Love
programme.desc: In the Big City, true love is increasingly hard to achieve. But what if brave souls, yearning for romance and a loving partnership, agree to a provocative proposal: getting married at first sight? This groundbreaking format offers a shockingly novel twist on the relationship, dating and wedding space. Four experts - a therapist, anthropologist, spiritualist and clinical psychologist - will create what they believe are three perfect couples. The twist is that these couples will never meet or know each other until they walk down the aisle and see each other face to face - for the first time - at the altar. Each self-contained episode will track classic lifestyle stories of newlyweds: the honeymoon; early nesting; meeting the in-laws; and other universally relatable events of married life. Will they remain together in the end, or decide to separate?

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: Hitler had expected a decisive victory in Russia, he was thwarted at every turn and while the Luftwaffe bombed Moscow and the Siege of Leningrad began, the Soviet Red Army refused to capitulate. They just watched and waited for the winter snows.

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: After 18 months of preparation, the Allied Expeditionary Force launches the largest amphibious landing in history, with 160,000 troops storming the Normandy coast. Facing years of German fortifications, success hinges on overcoming immense challenges during the critical first 24 hours. Victory remains uncertain as the world watches anxiously.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: The town of Hotten became very important during WWII as Hitler has ordered it held at all costs because of its key defensive location by the Siegfried Line. An infantry regiment and tanks attack but are stopped by heavy mortar fire. A small squad succeeds by using grenades and .45 submachine guns, allowing the tanks and infantry to take the town after a fierce fight. Stars actor Jim Hutton.

programme.title: Arnhem 1944
programme.desc: This is the tragic story of the last bridge in the ill-fated Operation Market-Garden, and features rare newsreel footage of the Allied operation that was supposed to end World War Two in 1944. Featuring extensive footage from the training films and newsreel cameras of both sides plus a return to the battlefield under the direction of Robert Kershaw, author of It Never Snows In September.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: On 22 June 1941, German pilots were the first to see the sun rise. Before the day was over, the Soviet Air Forces had lost almost 2 000 aircraft. The early German air superiority gave a significant boost to German confidence, and severely damaged Soviet military capability and morale.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: We review the heroic and inspiring work of the Army Chaplain, especially the Chaplains who have served so gallantly with our fighting troops. The soldier looks to this clergyman in uniform as a friend and counselor, as well as a spiritual leader.

programme.title: Architects of Darkness
programme.desc: The drug addicted dilettante who created the Luftwaffe. Goering was at Hitler's side from the ill-fated Beer Hall putsch of 1923 until the estrangement between the two in April 1945 when Hitler ordered Goering's arrest.

programme.title: Military Aircraft of the 20th Century: Transport Aircraft
programme.desc: Providing exact numbers, specifications, and plenty of facts, Military Aircraft of the 20th Century provides an encyclopedic look at aircrafts used by any military force in the 20th century. This entry focuses on transport aircraft, such as the Junkers JU-52, Douglas DC-3, PBY Catalina, Short Sunderland, and more.

programme.title: Anzac Battlefields: The Western Front
programme.desc: The ANZAC's feel the brunt of Germany's Operation Michael, the biggest offensive of World War I.

programme.title: Naval Warfare in World War II
programme.desc: In a last effort at glory, having lost most of their best men in military actions, Japan employs suicide pilots - Kamikaze - men who willingly crash their planes into ships in order to destroy the American spirit. But the U.S. Navy and Marines are ready for them with their guns, and they fought heroically against the onslaught. And on Okinawa, Americans fight a major battle with the Japanese Army.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: The landing of our paratroopers near Munsan. The crossing of the Imjin River by Republic of Korean troopsThe 'one-two punch' of the 8th Army, the tank-infantry team crosses the 38th Parallel. A brief report on the activation of SHAPE in Paris with a few words from the former General of the Army, Dwight D. Eisenhower.

programme.title: Impossible Peace
programme.desc: These are the best of times for the US. Prohibition doesn't stop anyone from having a good time, the country is on wheels or listening to the radio, welcoming the talkies or investing in the stock market with reckless optimism. It's that brief spell they call the Jazz Age, the age of Charles Lindbergh and Babe Ruth.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: This is the true story of an American paratrooper rescued by the French underground in Normandy under the noses of German troops. Meet Glen Robinson, a U.S. Captain, underground members, including lovely Lucienne, the Mute himself 'Gabby' Mosely. Nicknamed for his gift of gab, he assumes the identity of a deaf-mute to avoid capture and teams with Lucienne to sabotage enemy communications.

programme.title: Auschwitz - Voices of 44 Survivors
programme.desc: In 2006, some of the very few Jewish survivors told their stories on camera. How does one get out of Auschwitz? How do you recover from this hell? How do you recall and recount the atrocities of the camp? And how can we pass on the memory of the Holocaust?

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Some believe ghosts are human spirits seeking peace, while others say they are inhuman entities that feed on fear. Jan's lonely son Cody seems happy with his imaginary friend-until his behavior turns violent. When Cody reveals his friend lives in a red box in a cemetery, Jan seeks help from a Native American shaman. Through ancient rituals, she battles a force far more sinister than a lost soul.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Living together requires balance, but Mike and Lisa aren't alone in their new home. Lisa's behavior changes inexplicably, and Mike grows desperate for answers. A late-night encounter with an invisible force convinces him they are haunted. He sets up surveillance, watching and waiting. What he captures shakes him to the core-are ghosts real, or is he losing his mind?

programme.title: Castles & Palaces of Europe
programme.desc: Our journey starts with Hohenzollern Castle, the cradle of the last Prussian reigning family and a symbol of their power: an eagle's nest, perched on a green peak. After a trip to a snail farm, a culinary speciality of Swabia, we discover Ludwigsburg Castle, a small pleasure pavilion that gradually became one of Europe's largest baroque residences.

programme.title: The Egyptians
programme.desc: The tomb of the last queen of Egypt has never been found, despite experts searching for centuries. While many historians believe it is located near a temple to Isis, East of ancient Alexandria, new discoveries indicate that it might be near Taposiris Magna. Through field excavations, 3D modeling and reenactments, this documentary series will retrace the life of Cleopatra.

programme.title: The Vietnam War: Unknown Images
programme.desc: For the first three years of the war, the U.S. Infantry had two very different missions to win 'Hearts and Minds' and to 'Search & Destroy'. Join U.S. combat cameramen as they are choppered in alongside the troops to capture the fighting on assault operations including Starlight, Cedar Falls and Masher.

programme.title: The Napoleonic Wars - The War of the Sixth Coalition
programme.desc: The Russian army joins forces with European allies in a series of clashes across Central Europe. At Dresden and Kulm, the tide begins to turn against Napoleon. Fierce battles test the resolve of the coalition as momentum shifts toward the defenders of the old order.

programme.title: When the Egyptians Sailed on the Red Sea
programme.desc: This multi-awards film is the tale of an extraordinary human and scientific adventure. An adventure in which we are plunged into the technical and psychological world of the Egyptians 3,500 years ago.

programme.title: The Rise and Fall of Versailles
programme.desc: As a military leader, Louis XV, was popular and successful, but he led France into the disastrous Seven Year War with Britain. As his Empire dwindled, Louis amused himself with scandalous love affairs, his own private brothel and bedded five sisters from the same aristocratic family. This is a florid and hugely enjoyable saga of sex, war, torture, gluttony, and some truly astonishing wigs.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths
programme.desc: Perseus was not meant to come into the world. Fearing the fulfilment of the prediction according to which his grandson would kill him, King Acrisius shut his daughter Danaë away in a fortified tower.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths
programme.desc: The Goddess of War Athena was the wisest, most level headed and rational deity. She was born out of Zeus' skull, wearing a helmet and holding a spear. She was the protector of heroes, the State, and mankind, to whom she passed on many inventions.

programme.title: Welcome Spring: Royal Confectionery Spring Table <1>
programme.desc: Capturing the perfect snack that matches spring best, the sounds of making royal confectionery. Experience the taste and style filled with the scent of spring.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Secret Garden: Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace EP.2 <2>
programme.desc: Nakseonjae combines noble residence style with palace architecture, featuring unique decorative patterns that showcase late Joseon craftsmanship. Enjoy a break at the exclusive Rear Garden of Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: A Garden that Calms the Mind: Soswaewon Garden, Damyang <14>
programme.desc: Created by Yang San-bo in Damyang, Soswaewon is a beautiful garden symbolizing the dignified character and integrity of Korean scholar-officials from the Joseon Dynasty.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Way of the Scholar: Nakjukjangdo <46>
programme.desc: Jangdo is a small knife carried on the body for daily use, self-defense, or as an ornament. Nakjukjangdo is a traditional knife made using the Nakjuk technique. Appreciate Nakjukjangdo, used while walking the path of scholars.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Korea’s Representative Food Culture: Making Kimchi <32>
programme.desc: Kimchi, a representative food of Korea! Did you know that our kimchi-making culture is listed by UNESCO? Learn the tradition of making kimchi.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Creating a Four-Legged Table: Wooden Furniture Master <49>
programme.desc: Carpenters are artisans who make windows, woodenware, and wooden furniture. They continue the traditional woodworking techniques, creating works like the Sabangtakja (four-sided table). Appreciate the works of Carpenters.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Breathing Life into Hanji: Jiseung Master <33>
programme.desc: Paper can be crafted into various shapes of containers according to the maker’s intention. Welcome to the world of the Jiseung master.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Creating Folding Screens: Pasting Master <41>
programme.desc: Baechup is the traditional Korean technique for mounting calligraphy and paintings to enhance their preservation and beauty. Appreciate the master's craftmanship as he create a traditional ten-panel folding screen.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Listening to the Mountain Temple: Haenam Daeheungsa <8>
programme.desc: Daeheungsa is located in Duryunsan Provincial Park, a famous mountain in Haenam, with traces of famous monks. Feel the serene scenery and sounds of the temple.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Carving Printing Blocks: Engraving Master <40>
programme.desc: A master engraver carves letters or pictures into various materials like wood, copper, and stone, continuing a tradition passed down from ancient times.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Secret Garden: Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace EP.2 <2>
programme.desc: Nakseonjae combines noble residence style with palace architecture, featuring unique decorative patterns that showcase late Joseon craftsmanship. Enjoy a break at the exclusive Rear Garden of Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: A Garden that Calms the Mind: Soswaewon Garden, Damyang <14>
programme.desc: Created by Yang San-bo in Damyang, Soswaewon is a beautiful garden symbolizing the dignified character and integrity of Korean scholar-officials from the Joseon Dynasty.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Painting with Lacquer: The Process of Color Lacquer Art <82>
programme.desc: On a lacquered surface, colored patterns are drawn by hand, layer after layer. As each coat is applied and dried, time, patience, and vision build a work of beauty. Listen as brushstrokes blend with the passage of time.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Tradition Shaped by Many Hands: Gat Making Master <92>
programme.desc: Finely split bamboo forms the brim, while horsehair is woven into the crown. The Brim Maker, Crown Maker, and Gat Assembler bring their skills together to complete one elegant gat. Experience the harmony of three traditional crafts.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Iron and Flame: Forging a Traditional Cauldron <89>
programme.desc: Creating a cast iron cauldron demands fierce heat and skilled hands. As molten metal meets the mold, everyday tradition takes shape. Hear the depth of Korean casting craft in each heavy echo.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Casting a Temple Bell: Iron Casting Master <96>
programme.desc: Molten metal flows into a massive mold as a temple bell begins to take shape. Its patterns, thickness, and resonance are all carefully considered. Hear the powerful harmony of fire and iron as the bell is born.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Forging My Protector: Crafting the Ornamental Blade <83>
programme.desc: Shaping a blade begins with fire and hammer. In the forging of this small sword lies the essence of strength, rhythm, and tradition. Hear the iron sing as each strike reveals the artisan’s devotion.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Crafting Roof Tiles: Roof Tile Making Master <95>
programme.desc: Clay is kneaded, shaped in molds, and hardened by sunlight and fire to become roof tiles for a hanok. The artisan balances strength with graceful curves in every piece. Hear the steady rhythm of earth taking shape.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Thousands of Scissor Cuts: Preparing the Pyebaek Table <88>
programme.desc: On the traditional wedding table, squid is transformed into a phoenix through thousands of cuts and rolls. Each motion reflects a heartfelt wish for blessings. Listen closely to the artistry of ritual cuisine.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Echoes of Farewell: Folk Song of Funeral Procession <94>
programme.desc: Slow footsteps and solemn voices accompany the final journey of the departed. Sung as the funeral bier is carried to the burial site, these folk songs once united communities in remembrance and farewell. Listen to the echoes that linger between life and death.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Doble vida

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - En la boca del lobo

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Juan Gabriel íntimo

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - La amenaza de la amapola
programme.desc: En los campos de la Sierra de Guerrero, México, florecen la amapola y la violencia. Familias campesinas se ganan la vida con los cultivos ilegales, mientras que los carteles de la droga buscan controlar el mercado.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Traicionados por la justicia

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Alas del narco
programme.desc: El drama de las misteriosas desapariciones de pilotos y los riesgos a los que se exponen en las selvas andinas.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Amores que matan

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - ¿Comida cruel?
programme.desc: Una pareja acepta el reto de cambiar sus hábitos alimenticios, dejar de comer carne y llevar una dieta balanceada. Y la historia de Yumalay Díaz, un niño de 4 años que, con su participación en un reality, quiere cambiar su vida y la de sus papás.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Burlando la muerte
programme.desc: Personas que por diferentes razones del destino han estado al borde de la muerte, pero han recibido una segunda oportunidad para continuar con sus vidas. Desde accidentes con puentes desplomados, ataques por celos, sobrevivientes de terremotos y más.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Chicos malos

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Muerte río arriba

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Atorados

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Caminando al borde

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Magnates de Dios

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Lay confiesa su eterno amor por Aurelio, viaja a Colombia y pone en riesgo su vida para verlo. En un intento desesperado por no ser deportada, Leonor acepta casarse con Ignacio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica está lista para matar a Lay: Ella revela que fue Tijeras quien orquestó el ataque, y deben escapar juntas. Ximena cubre a Heriberto cuando Chacorta llega a la casa.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Después de la emboscada, Mauricio se siente traicionado y quiere venganza. Aurelio, Mónica y Lay llegan a México. Santiago viaja a solas con Ximena y le propone matrimonio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tras acusarla de darle pistas falsas sobre Aurelio, el Chema le pide a Matilde información sobre Chacorta. Leonor quiere que Victoria la ayude a encontrar a Ximena.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema amenaza a Mónica para que lo ponga en contacto con Francisco, sin saber que hablan del propio Aurelio. Ella le revela que está embarazada para que dejen de golpearla.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio denuncia al Chema con la Interpol, en un intento desesperado por rescatar a Mónica. Leonor comienza a seguir a Ximena, mientras Ignacio y Victoria le ayudan a conseguir información.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Después de una balacera con agentes de Interpol, la DEA captura al Chema, quien intenta sobornarlos. Santiago le sugiere que Heriberto se entregue para proteger a Ximena.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Leonor le exige a Ximena que entregue a Aurelio y, a cambio, le propone dejar en paz a Heriberto. Lay busca asociarse con Iñaqui para operar el tráfico de drogas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Leo se debate entre escapar con una compañera de prisión o quedarse y confiar en que Ignacio la libere por vías legales. Mónica le dice a Aurelio que quiere tener un hijo suyo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema le pide a Andrews que vigile a Elsa porque ella es pieza clave para su huida de la cárcel. Leonor sigue a Ximena y descubre nuevas pistas que la sorprenden.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le pide a Lay que consiga pasaportes españoles para él, Mónica y Heriberto porque necesitan huir. Mónica tiene miedo de perder a su bebé y pide que la lleven a un hospital.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema manda a Tijeras y Tostado a cumplir su amenaza contra el hijo de Chacorta. Víctor recibe un disparo en cada pierna. Doña Alba le reclama a Aurelio por el dolor que sufre la familia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victor culpa a su padre y su tío de la desgracia que está viviendo, y le dice a Chacorta que ellos solo siembran muerte y destrucción en la familia. Mónica está desconsolada tras perder al bebé.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: La guerra entre bandas del narcotráfico apenas comienza. Aurelio promete venganza: sugiere a Chacorta que trasladen el negocio a España y vigilen a Chema, quien podría escapar de prisión.

programme.desc: When it comes to dating, they say age is just a number. But what happens when the man is more than two decades older than his girlfriend, or the woman is 15 years older than her young lover? Forty-year-old Sanjay is a wealthy cosmetic surgeon who met 18-year-old Jacqueline on the Web site SugarDaddie.com. They’ve only been together for four months and are already talking marriage. Sanjay’s friend, Mike, is convinced that Jacqueline will put him right in the poorhouse! Is there a chance that Sanjay has found true love, or is Jacqueline just in it for the money? Then, 24-year-old Ryan is engaged to Angela, a woman 15 years his senior. Ryan’s friend, Donovan, fears that Angela is alienating Ryan from his buddies. Will Ryan have to choose between his college friends and his soon-to-be wife?

programme.title: Elevator Screamer
programme.desc: With a record number of Americans trading city life for homes in the suburbs, relationships between neighbors are being put to the test. Each half-hour episode of "Neighborhood Wars" takes viewers into the homes and backyards of neighbors across the country with some of the most unexpected and emotionally charged events caught on camera. Featuring footage from cell phones, drones, home security cameras and more, the series showcases the kindness and conflict between real-life neighbors throughout the US.

programme.title: Home is Where Your Spouse Is
programme.desc: In the Big City, true love is increasingly hard to achieve. But what if brave souls, yearning for romance and a loving partnership, agree to a provocative proposal: getting married at first sight? This groundbreaking format offers a shockingly novel twist on the relationship, dating and wedding space. Four experts - a therapist, anthropologist, spiritualist and clinical psychologist - will create what they believe are three perfect couples. The twist is that these couples will never meet or know each other until they walk down the aisle and see each other face to face - for the first time - at the altar. Each self-contained episode will track classic lifestyle stories of newlyweds: the honeymoon; early nesting; meeting the in-laws; and other universally relatable events of married life. Will they remain together in the end, or decide to separate?

Andy tries to debunk some alarms that get tripped on their own.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Brian leaves TAPS. Andy persuades Jason and Grant to investigate a haunted lighthouse. Steve and Andy experience a cold spot but nothing else happens. The team doesn't capture any evidence of a haunting.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Steve gets promoted to Tech Manager. TAPS takes on a case that has a personal connection for Kristyn, one of their members. A little boy claims he is being attacked by an entity while his mother suffers dizzy spells whenever she's in the basement. The team discovers high EMF readings and concludes this could be the cause of the dizzy spells since there carbon monoxide leaks weren't detected.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS searches for paranormal evidence at a lavish historical estate in Rhode Island. They debunk the cold spots in the basement when they find a blocked heating system. The victim is so frightened she won't allow herself to be seen on camera. TAPS captures recorded sounds of footsteps in her home just as she had reported.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS welcomes an investigator in training, Dave Tango, from the NJ group. TAPS heads the upstate NY to investigate a former insane asylum. They gather no evidence but run into some dive-bombing bats.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to California to investigate two locations at the top of their Most Haunted list. The first stop is the Winchester Mystery House in San Jose where Dave and Donna's inexperience in the tech department starts to annoy Steve. Jason and Grant debunk cold spots. They don't capture any evidence of paranormal activity. At the Queen Mary in Long Beach, the team seems overwhelmed by the size of the ship. programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS goes to Ohio to investigate Mansfield State Penitentiary, the location of The Shawshank Redemption film. Dave and Dustin chase a dark shadow down one of the cell blocks. Jason and Grant hear an unseen visitor running on the walkway above them. The team fails to collect any ghostly evidence. They head to Massachusetts and investigate the former home of the infamous Lizzie Borden who was accused of viciously murdering her father and step-mother with an axe.

programme.desc: However shocking the crime, media headlines eventually fade, but for heartbroken friends and family, the memories and their longing for justice never do. Cold Case Files? produced by the team behind Investigative ReportsTM, digs deep into the past, following detectives as they strive to breathe new life into "cold" unsolved crimes. Armed with the latest DNA technology and with dogged determination, investigators seek new leads in hopes of bringing the guilty to justice decades after the crimes have been committed. Whether it's a man who was initially a prime suspect in his son's death, watching as the police begin to suspect his wife or the gruesome shooting of an elderly couple whose bodies were found in the woods, each episode features a different cold case.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Spices impart a lot of flavor to a recipe, and today Lidia shows viewers how to use different spices. programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Pan pizza and a mozzarella cheeseburger using focaccia, mozzarella, pickled peperoncino and a grilled tomato; crispy baked chicken cutlets.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Winter always proved to be a tough time for the garden, but this only made cold weather crops more valuable on Lidia's family table. Recipes in this episode include a delicious Orecchiette with Breadcrumbs, Pancetta, and Cauliflower, and a unique and flavorful Cabbage Salad topped with a warm dressing.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There is nothing better than a great piece of meat! In today's episode, Lidia takes a less expensive cut, London Broil, and marinate it to perfection. Her menu includes a delicious Vegetable Patty served with green salad which works as an appetizer or by itself as a quick lunch, London Broil with Sun Dried Tomato Marinade and one of her Grandma Rosa's favorite Corn and Walnut Cake

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia fell in love with the sea growing up near the Adriatic's beautiful rocky beaches. Fishing trips with Uncle Emilio were always a lot of hard work, but definitely worth the delicious reward. Today, she prepares a Grilled Calamari Salad with Tomato Coulis, Toasted Bread with Basil Cannellini, and a Whole Roasted Branzino where everything is done in the oven for a trouble-free cleanup.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fresh pasta is an Italian family tradition passed through the generations. Today she starts with a silky pappardelle pasta dressed with pesto made from walnut, basil and parsley. She then takes the same pasta dough and shapes it into Tortelloni stuffed with spinach and ricotta, dressed with a classic marinara sauce.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America: Return of the Artisans Season 1
programme.desc: Lidia Bastianich travels the country to meet with American makers who are mastering the art of meat curing, coopering, coppersmithing, jam-making, cider-making, and more-and finds out what inspires and fuels them. She sees how artisanal crafts and small businesses are a fulfilling way to earn a livelihood, and how many craftspeople are bringing their skills back to their own communities.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There is nothing more delicious than butterflied poultry with super crispy chicken. In this episode, Lidia starts with a Spicy Butterflied Cornish Hen made with hot cherry peppers, rosemary and wine. She then pulls out the beer to add to her Potatoes Baked in Beer .Our favorite Grandma Erminia joins Lidia to taste the Squash and Ricotta Tart.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia's first home economics class as a teenager in New York confirmed her passion for food. Despite the differences compared to what she was used to, she was determined to explore it all. Lidia starts off with Lasagna with Ricotta and Mozzarella, a dish she remembers from when she was first introduced to Italian American food. She follows this with a flavorful Escarole Olive Oil Mashed Potatoes, and finishes with Baked Stuffed Vegetables, a very satisfying mixture.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America
programme.desc: Join beloved chef and cookbook author Lidia Bastianich on a deeply personal culinary journey to four celebrations of independence, to share in the wonderful diversity of American culture and food.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love cheese, and back in the kitchen, Lidia shares her favorite cheesy appetizers - Baked Goat Cheese, Fava, and Artichoke Dip, baked to golden to perfection; and Baked Stuffed Vegetables, a recipe Lidia often makes when cooking for her family.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: When a holiday or special occasion goes around, it's time to go above and beyond with an extra special feast. Today, Lidia shares some of her best recipes to do just that. Her Wedding Soup is a classic Italian dish that marries the vegetables and meatballs in a delicious pot of soup; Prosecco Punch, made with raspberries and nectarines is a real crowd pleaser, and finally you can't go wrong with a beautiful Roasted Lamb Shoulder with Carrots and Parsnips, a rich and flavorful one pot meal.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia has always loved trips to the food market. From her days as a small child preparing to go to the market with her grandmother to searching for seasonal produce today, it has always been an adventure. Recipes in this episode include a Shrimp, Roasted Pepper and Olive Salad and a delicious vegetarian Eggplant Parmigiana Stacks.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Olive oil is an essential staple in every Italian home. It's the easiest way to add flavor to any soup, and Lidia shows you how when making Cannellini Bean and Lentil Soup. Olive oil is also used in desserts, and she makes Olive Oil Cake.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today's recipes are dedicated to the family. They can be made for a weeknight dinner or a large gathering or holiday and include: Oven Braised Pork Chops with Red Onion and Pears; Cherry Jam Tart. To start, Lidia enjoys a special Cherry Bellini.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In today's episode, Lidia shows you how to brunch Italian-style. On the menu are Herb Frittata Roll-Ups, a wonderful appetizer to pass around at a cocktail party or for a buffet brunch; Pancetta with Fennel-Flavored Eggs and Apples, a delicious breakfast or brunch dish served with lots of crusty bread; and Potato and Egg Frico, a favorite breakfast dish in Lidia's family, in which potatoes and cheese are baked together.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: A light version of chicken parmigiana; rice balls stuffed with sausage ragu; Lidia's traditional Bolognese sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: Here Comes the Stranger
programme.desc: In the Big City, true love is increasingly hard to achieve. But what if brave souls, yearning for romance and a loving partnership, agree to a provocative proposal: getting married at first sight? This groundbreaking format offers a shockingly novel twist on the relationship, dating and wedding space. Four experts - a therapist, anthropologist, spiritualist and clinical psychologist - will create what they believe are three perfect couples. The twist is that these couples will never meet or know each other until they walk down the aisle and see each other face to face - for the first time - at the altar. Each self-contained episode will track classic lifestyle stories of newlyweds: the honeymoon; early nesting; meeting the in-laws; and other universally relatable events of married life. Will they remain together in the end, or decide to separate?

Meanwhile, Coughlin's 17-year-old daughter soon experiences a change of heart when she witnesses the immense bravery of a Black teen and her father.

This is a biting, wry comedy examining the elements that make a man a monster.

Cherry (Rose McGowan), a go-go dancer, and Wray (Freddy Rodriguez), her ex-lover, band together with other survivors in a no-holds barred effort to escape the carnage. The odds become a bit more even when Cherry, who lost her leg to a hungry ghoul, gets a machine-gun appendage and lets the bullets fly.

Edward (Ethan Hawke), a vampire hematologist, tries to develop a blood substitute when he meets Lionel (Willem Dafoe) and Audrey (Claudia Karvan), two fugitive humans who claim to have a possible cure. programme.title: The Tulip Bubble
programme.desc: In 1637, Dutch tulip mania created the first major market bubble, offering timeless financial lessons.

programme.title: The Siege Of Leningrad
programme.desc: The Siege of Leningrad began on 8 SEP 1941. For 872 days the city was surrounded by the German Armed Forces.

programme.title: The Dictator
programme.desc: Hidden in archives and private collections, images of the Third Reich have also been preserved - in colour.

programme.title: Afghanistan 1979-1989
programme.desc: This project aims to understand the causes of the Afghan war (1979-1989) and its accurate coverage. It started on Dec 12, 1979, when the Politburo members (Leonid Brezhnev, Yuri Andropov, Andrey Gromyko, Dmitry Ustinov) decided to send troops. It was the Soviet Union's first operation outside the Warsaw Pact, becoming their longest and forgotten war.

programme.title: Sword of Honour
programme.desc: The story is one man's heroic quest to fight for a deep moral cause and to reclaim his manhood after a shattering divorce from society beauty Virginia Troy.

programme.title: The Amazing World of War Machines
programme.desc: Rockets and guided missiles are the essential component of any military arsenal. By definition, rockets are unguided and follow the laws of physics and trajectory; whereas missiles are guided, either remotely or internally. There are many different types of missiles, including anti-tank and anti-aircraft missiles, surface to air missiles, and ballistic missiles.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: On 27 November 1942, the French fleet scuttled itself in Toulon, sending over 85 warships to the seabed to avoid German capture. This tragic act, born of defeat and collaboration, crippled the French Navy. Using archives, survivor accounts, and vivid reconstructions, the film revisits this dramatic and rarely explored chapter of World War II history.

programme.title: WWII: The Price of Empire
programme.desc: There was a plot that eventually Germany, headed east and Japan, heading west, would eventually join up in the Indian subcontinent to make a massive territory. But too many setbacks in 1942 marked the end of the beginning.

programme.title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War
programme.desc: The mantle of invisibility surrounding German forces had slipped an fallen since Stalingrad and panzer units suffering heavy loses. A revitalized red army began to payback hitler in a brutal attack as the last months of ww2 passed. Stalin was obsessed with the significance of one town which brought the most terrible end to WW2 in Berlin that anyone could have imagined.

programme.title: The Crimean War
programme.desc: The final program looks at the aftermath of the war with Germany, with Italy and Romania springing up from the ashes of the confrontation. Meanwhile, in defeated Russia, the peasants and serfs where sowing the seeds of a future revolution.

programme.title: War in the Pacific
programme.desc: After three years, the Allies free the Philippines. Battles of Leyte, Manilla and Luzon.

programme.title: The Rise and Fall of Adolf Hitler
programme.desc: Volume 3 - Why Hitler lost World War II: Examines the enormous sacrifice the free world paid to defeat Nazi Germany and examines Adolf Hitler's thirst for power and his bumbling military errors including letting the BEF escape at Dunkirk.

programme.title: Bombers of WWII: Allied & Axis Bombers
programme.desc: Using authentic footage; this program covers the finer details, advantages and shortcomings of the bombers used by the British, Americans and Germans during World War II. Bombers include: The Avro Lancaster, Halifax, Manchester, Short Stirling, Wellington, the B-17 Flying Fortress, B-25 Mitchell, B-24 Liberator, Heinkel He 111, Junkers 88 and Junkers 188, He 177 & the Stuka Ju-87 Dive Bomber.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: As Hitler focussed on Russia, the situation in the Pacific developed to epic proportions when the Japanese air force attacked the American Naval Fleet at Pearl Harbour on the 7th of December. This immediately brought the USA into the Theatre of War.

programme.title: The Rise and Fall of Versailles
programme.desc: The life and loves of France's most famous king, Louis XIV. Dubbed the Sun King by his admiring court, Louis conquered half of Europe, conducted dozens of love affairs and dazzled his contemporaries with his lavish entertainments. But perhaps his greatest achievement - and certainly his longest lasting love - was the incredible palace he built at Versailles, one of the wonders of the world.

programme.title: Queen Victoria's Letters: A Monarch Unveiled
programme.desc: AN Wilson reveals that Victoria and Albert's relationship was far from idyllic. Behind closed doors Albert showed his true colours as a control freak.

programme.title: Marie Antoinette: The Trial of a Queen
programme.desc: On the night of August 2, 1793, Marie Antoinette is transferred to the Conciergerie. Her husband has been sent to the guillotine, her children have been taken away, all the other European monarchies have abandoned her and France is calling for her head. She was judged as a queen, her tragic death made her immortal. Thanks to secret documents freshly decoded this film grasps her last days.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths: The Odyssey
programme.desc: The Suitors, informed by Melantho - one of Penelope's servants - learned that the queen had fooled them. They locked her up in the gynaeceum. Meanwhile, Odysseus meets Athena who tells him that he is indeed in Ithaca.

programme.title: For Athens
programme.desc: This immersion into Ancient Greece, filmed in the original language, follows in the footsteps of Themistocles and his fearsome adversary Xerxes. Through two spectacular military engagements, one on land, the other naval: the battles of Marathon (490 BC) and Salamis (480 BC).

programme.title: Ships That Changed the World
programme.desc: The arrival of menacing German U-Boats in international waters rewrote the rulebook on maritime conflict, and so Britain began rapidly converting its merchant vessels into battleships. Sea battles such as those at Cornell and Jutland saw the two empire's differing approaches put to the test - pitting Germany's sub-surface sneak attacks and strong defenses against Britain's brute force.

programme.title: 1000 AD: Anglo-Saxons vs Vikings
programme.desc: What was it really like to live just before the end of the first millennium? 1000 AD recreates life circa 999 AD, showing the everyday lives, loves and passions of the Anglo-Saxon people. A soap opera-style drama runs alongside interviews with leading historians who paint a revealing picture of the political and social structure of pre-Norman Britain.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: It's said that every photograph steals a piece of a soul. What happens when the subject is dead? Lisa becomes obsessed with a photo of her boyfriend's brother, killed in Vietnam. As her fixation deepens, she experiences waking visions of the soldier and believes the picture has a life of its own. When her daughters report supernatural encounters, Lisa realizes the spirit is taking control.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Some believe knowledge comes from reason, others from intuition. When Selena moves into an old Michigan house, she senses danger. The attic makes her dizzy, the kitchen feels watched, and photos reveal ghostly faces. With proof of a haunting, she and her sister seek a psychic's help. He confirms the worst-the house is a place of suffering, trapping both the living and the dead.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: The Bible tells of a man possessed by a legion of demons. In Stamford, Connecticut, 12-year-old David has nightmares of a demonic old man flying toward his home. His terror grows daily. His mother is unsure how to respond-until David is physically attacked by an unseen force. Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren discover demons within him. They must act before he is lost to darkness.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Some Native American myths tell of supernatural creatures guarding the dead. Early explorers spoke of werewolves and the Wendigo. When Randy discovers a Native American skeleton beneath his home, he recites an incantation, hoping to make contact. Soon, a cold, growling monster appears, attacking his loved ones. The spirits don't want the house-they want him, and they won't let go.

programme.title: Crafting Paper to Last a Thousand Years: Hanji Making Master <97>
programme.desc: Mulberry bark is boiled, beaten, and spread into fibers to form a sheet of hanji. Through repeated dipping and careful handling, the artisan creates paper that is both strong and soft. Experience the quiet rhythm of hanji rising from the water.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Carving Printing Blocks: Engraving Master <40>
programme.desc: A master engraver carves letters or pictures into various materials like wood, copper, and stone, continuing a tradition passed down from ancient times.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Legacy of Sound: Daegeum Master <42>
programme.desc: Daegeum, which is one of Korea's representative traditional instruments is a wind instrument with holes drilled into bamboo to produce sound. Let’s follow the work process of these artisans who keep the tradition alive.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Mystical Hidden Scenery: Jusanji Pond, Cheongsong EP.3 <11>
programme.desc: Completed in 1720, Jusanji Pond is fed by clear waters from Byeolbawi Rock and surrounded by lush forests of Juwangsan Mountain, creating a serene, otherworldly atmosphere.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Secret Garden: Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace EP.2 <2>
programme.desc: Nakseonjae combines noble residence style with palace architecture, featuring unique decorative patterns that showcase late Joseon craftsmanship. Enjoy a break at the exclusive Rear Garden of Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Painting with Lacquer: The Process of Color Lacquer Art <82>
programme.desc: On a lacquered surface, colored patterns are drawn by hand, layer after layer. As each coat is applied and dried, time, patience, and vision build a work of beauty. Listen as brushstrokes blend with the passage of time.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Tradition Shaped by Many Hands: Gat Making Master <92>
programme.desc: Finely split bamboo forms the brim, while horsehair is woven into the crown. The Brim Maker, Crown Maker, and Gat Assembler bring their skills together to complete one elegant gat. Experience the harmony of three traditional crafts.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Crafting Roof Tiles: Roof Tile Making Master <95>
programme.desc: Clay is kneaded, shaped in molds, and hardened by sunlight and fire to become roof tiles for a hanok. The artisan balances strength with graceful curves in every piece. Hear the steady rhythm of earth taking shape.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Forging My Protector: Crafting the Ornamental Blade <83>
programme.desc: Shaping a blade begins with fire and hammer. In the forging of this small sword lies the essence of strength, rhythm, and tradition. Hear the iron sing as each strike reveals the artisan’s devotion.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Iron and Flame: Forging a Traditional Cauldron <89>
programme.desc: Creating a cast iron cauldron demands fierce heat and skilled hands. As molten metal meets the mold, everyday tradition takes shape. Hear the depth of Korean casting craft in each heavy echo.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Hand Skills of Joseon Artisans: Hat Making Master <77>
programme.desc: The tanggeon, a horsehair hat once worn under the gat, reflected dignity in the daily lives of Joseon men. Densely woven by skilled hands, it reveals the calm elegance and restraint found in traditional craftsmanship.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Exquisite Details of Joseon: Traditional Headwear <61>
programme.desc: With threads finer than hair, artisans weave traditional headgear that once reflected dignity and etiquette. Manggeon and Tanggeon, more than mere accessories, embody the refined aesthetic of Joseon craftsmanship.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Secret of Hanji that Lasts a Thousand Years: Stripping Mulberry Bark <54>
programme.desc: Traditional Hanji possesses excellent value, enduring for a thousand years without changing. Let’s appreciate the process of stripping the bark from mulberry trees, the main raw material in the creation of traditional Hanji.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Carrying on Korea’s Archery Tradition: Bow and Arrow Making Master <93>
programme.desc: Bamboo, horn, sinew, and wood come together to form a traditional bow and arrow. Each material is carefully shaped through countless steps, preserving Korea’s long archery tradition. Listen to the rhythm of carving and polishing.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Essence of Korean Traditional Dance: Salpuri Dance <34>
programme.desc: Since ancient times, people have held shamanistic rituals to dispel bad luck for the year. The Salpuri dance is an improvised dance performed by shamans during these rituals to ward off negative energy.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Legacy of Traditional Metal Type: Metal Type Master <19>
programme.desc: Metal type refers to various sizes of type made by melting metal and pouring it into molds for letterpress printing. Learn about the history and production process of metal type.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Full of Sensations: Royal Confectionery Tea Table <2>
programme.desc: Let’s make a tea table full of sensations! Experience various delicacies filled with dedication and handmade taste, such as mugwort rice cake balls (Ssukguridan) and twisted flour dough flower rice cakes.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Beauty of Patience: Ottchil Master <45>
programme.desc: A Ottchil Master is an artisan skilled in decorating objects and furniture surfaces beautifully with ottchil (natural varnish/lacquer) and shells. Appreciate the works filled with the dedication and patience of the Lacquerware Master.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Artistic Peak of Knotting: Knot Master <50>
programme.desc: Knot Masters are artisans who use strings to make various types of knots and tassels. Appreciate the works of Knot Masters who have reached the height of art in Dahoe knot making.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Way of the Scholar: Nakjukjangdo <46>
programme.desc: Jangdo is a small knife carried on the body for daily use, self-defense, or as an ornament. Nakjukjangdo is a traditional knife made using the Nakjuk technique. Appreciate Nakjukjangdo, used while walking the path of scholars.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: A Bowl Made by the Sea: Tongyeong Neomul Bibimbap <35>
programme.desc: There are various regional versions of traditional bibimbap, but Tongyeong's version is accompanied by tofu soup. Experience the special bibimbap of Tongyeong.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Sound of Swamp: Upo Wetlands <26>
programme.desc: How much time has passed in Upo Wetlands? It is a story of lives that have settled and live like masters in the place provided by the river.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Elegant Beauty of Hanok: A Day in an Old House <10>
programme.desc: Feel the charm of traditional Hanok through a day in an old house, from the sound of sweeping the wide yard before sunrise, the scene of a mother cooking, to the crackling sound of burning firewood.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Buscando en el desierto
programme.desc: Familias que pierden a sus seres queridos en la inmensidad del desierto sin poder hacer nada para saber de ellos, pero la esperanza no muere y arriesgarán todo para recuperarlos. Migrantes que intentan cruzar la frontera hacia los Estados Unidos, mueren.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Amores migrantes
programme.desc: Ni el tiempo, ni el espacio, ni las fronteras son obstáculos para estar con la persona amada, hombres y mujeres que han hecho grandes sacrificios para estar unidos. Incluso arriesgan su libertad por estar junto a sus seres queridos.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - La viuda negra
programme.desc: Una terrible confusión pone en riesgo la libertad de un hombre tras el terrible asesinato de un importante empresario canadiense, pero el destino tiene sorpresas para todos.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Secretos de las mucamas de Trump
programme.desc: Declaraciones de mujeres que trabajaron para la familia Trump y secretos que salen a la luz después de las fuertes palabras del presidente contra miles de personas.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Ganarle a la muerte
programme.desc: La desgracia de un hombre que, con fuerza y voluntad, cambió su vida tratando de ayudar a sus seres amados. Cuando apenas emprendía el viaje para vivir el sueño americano, la tragedia se cruza en su camino.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Supremacistas: Las redes del odio
programme.desc: El cambio de vida de los inmigrantes que residen en El Paso, Texas. Sus miedos luego de las masacres del 3 de agosto de 2019, cuando un pistolero mató a 22 personas y les declaró la guerra a los hispanos.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Asesinadas
programme.desc: La historia de cinco mujeres que han sufrido de la violencia física. Un desenlace común tras una vida llena de tortura, la muerte es inevitable. Los feminicidios es alarmante, el porcentaje aumenta.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Desafiar el olvido
programme.desc: Algunos fueron perseguidos y separados de sus familias, otros llevados a campos de concentración y exterminados, hoy, algunos de los sobrevivientes narran el horror del holocausto judío.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - La vida en juego: fútbol y violencia en la frontera
programme.desc: Un programa especial que muestra la vida de cuatro jugadores de fútbol americano en Brownsville, Texas; quienes se enfrentan a una dura realidad de violencia, pobreza y drogas, pero siempre con ilusión de una vida mejor.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Un crimen casi perfecto
programme.desc: Una hermosa mujer y de buen corazón, es asesinada por su esposo, un hombre manipulador y frío que dejó abandonada a su propia hija en los brazos de su madre fallecida.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Narcosubmarinos: Viaje al fondo del mal
programme.desc: Por décadas, el narcotráfico ha navegado sigilosamente por los mares más peligrosos durante años, para poder transportar su mercancía, poniendo en peligro la vida de sus tripulantes a cambio de dinero.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Radiografía de una masacre
programme.desc: Una familia destruida tras un inesperado ataque con armas de fuego, habla sobre todo el sufrimiento que tuvieron que pasar al perder a sus seres queridos en manos de organizaciones delictivas. Una de las masacres más sangrientas y terribles de México.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - El hijo de El Chapo captura y liberación de un intocable
programme.desc: El ejército mexicano despliega un operativo en Culiacán, Sinaloa para detener a un familiar de Joaquín Guzmán Loera 'El Chapo'. El objetivo es capturado, durante un día Culiacán queda atrapado en un enfrentamiento entre el ejército y los narcos.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Fentanilo la nueva apuesta del narco
programme.desc: México es país productor y de tránsito de Fentanilo, un opioide sintético el cual es cada vez más consumido en Estados Unidos. Esta droga causa muchas muertes entre jóvenes. Un kilo de fentanilo genera las mismas ganancias que una tonelada de cocaína.

programme.title: La Mujer y la Bestia

programme.title: Museo del horror

programme.desc: Tomás les cuenta a sus amigos que Joaquín lo obliga a vender droga. Mía y Celina descubren que Vico les mintió para que se enojaran. Joaquín planea que Tomás venda droga afuera del colegio. Mía le pide a Alma que investigue todo sobre Valeria.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 71
programme.desc: Tomás le dice al director que él no es quien vende las drogas, se escapa de la escuela y comienzan a buscarlo. Franco piensa que Alma le manda mensajes de amor. Pascual regaña a la maestra de baile por culpa de Roberta.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 72
programme.desc: Miguel distrae al prefecto para poder llevar a cabo su plan de encontrar las drogas y ayudar a Tomás. El director contrata perros de seguridad para encontrar drogas en la escuela. Roberta descubre que Alma y Mía se traen algo entre manos.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 73
programme.desc: Roberta no deja de pensar en Diego. Mía y Lupita ayudan a arreglarse a Celina para la gran cita con Augusto. Alma y Mía confirman que Valeria y Franco se fueron juntos de viaje. Mía descubre a Miguel coqueteando con otra chava.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 74
programme.desc: Mía llora desconsolada porque sabe que Miguel desprecia su manera de ser. Roberta visita a Lupita y se queda a dormir en su casa. Nico deja plantada a Karen por quedarse en casa de Lupita. Celina tiene su primera cita con Augusto.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 75
programme.desc: Galia cuestiona a Pilar sobre el consumo de drogas de Joaquín. Roberta recibe un mensaje de Facundo. Durante el ensayo, Celina les muestra las canciones que escribió Mía. Alma teme que su exesposo le quite a su hija. El padre de Roberta llega a buscarla.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 76
programme.desc: Alma le cuenta a Franco que el papá de Roberta se la quiere llevar a España. Mía tiene una fuerte discusión con Vico, quien la golpea. Roberta se sorprende al ver a su papá y se entera que se tiene que ir con él. Mía le reclama a Julieta por su canción.

programme.title: El complot mongol
programme.desc: Filiberto García es un policía asignado para evitar un atentado contra el presidente de Estados Unidos, en una visita a México. Filiberto se pondrá en peligro por cumplir su misión, pero en el amor, encontrará una valiosa recompensa.

programme.title: El Chanfle
programme.desc: El 'Chanfle' es el aguador de un equipo de fútbol, es un hombre honesto al que le piden que haga trampa durante un juego. Él se niega y es despedido de su trabajo, pero su amigo, el médico del equipo tratará de que regrese.

programme.title: El Chanfle 2
programme.desc: Debido a una confusión, El Chanfle recibe un balón lleno de joyas de contrabando. A su vez, su esposa Tere intercambia una bolsa de pañales sucios por una gran cantidad de dinero. Sin saberlo, ambos están siendo parte de una cómica red delictiva.

programme.title: La señora Muerte
programme.desc: Un científico loco junto con una desfigurada y malvada mujer secuestran a bonitas jovencitas, con el fin de operarlas para utilizar sus perfectos rasgos en la maltrecha mujer, que ansía volver a ser hermosa.

programme.title: Santo y Blue Demon contra los monstruos
programme.desc: El malvado Dr. Bruno Halder vuelve de la muerte para vengarse de El Santo y Blue Demon, sus archienemigos. Para lograr su cometido crea una serie de monstruos, con los cuales también pretende acabar con su hermano Otto y a su sobrina Gloria.

programme.title: Santo y Blue Demon en el mundo de los muertos
programme.desc: El Santo tiene que luchar contra 'El Demonio' rey de la tinieblas en el mundo de los muertos para salvar el alma de su amada.

programme.title: Santo y Blue Demon contra los monstruos
programme.desc: El malvado Dr. Bruno Halder vuelve de la muerte para vengarse de El Santo y Blue Demon, sus archienemigos. Para lograr su cometido crea una serie de monstruos, con los cuales también pretende acabar con su hermano Otto y a su sobrina Gloria.

programme.title: Tres Veces Ana Capítulo 50
programme.desc: Santiago le dice a Soledad que la ayudará para que no la separen de Ana Lucía. Valentín descubre a Ana Leticia, ella le advierte que no busque vengarse de Mariano. Ramiro le confiesa a Ana Leticia que antes de morir Marcelo supo que ella tenía una amante.

programme.title: Tres Veces Ana Capítulo 51
programme.desc: Ana Leticia le revela a Leonor que su nuevo novio es Ramiro. Leonor queda sorprendida al ver a Marcelo con vida. Ana Laura le cuenta a Mariano que Ramiro y ella le están tendiendo una trampa a Ana Leticia para desenmascarar todas sus mentiras.

programme.title: Pasión Capítulo 6
programme.desc: Doña Francisca accede a llevar la carta de Camila. Santiago logra caminar de nuevo. Antillano roba otro barco y se lo cuenta a Foreman. Llega la carta de Camila y Rita la lee y la rompe. Timoteo le dice a Camila que se casen y ella pide ayuda a Lisabeta.

programme.title: Pasión Capítulo 7
programme.desc: Francisca le dice a Camila que le ayudará a escapar. Timoteo se da cuenta que Camila se fue y corre a Lisabeta y Francisca de la casa. Camila logra escapar de la casa pero cuando está por zarpar el barco, Timoteo la encuentra y se la lleva.

programme.title: Pasión Capítulo 8
programme.desc: Santiago llega al puerto con Vasco, pero no averiguan nada de Camila. Timoteo pone a Camila entre venderla a un burdel o casarse con él. Timoteo muestra el testamento a Lisabeta y Francisca donde aclara su herencia, pero después lo rompe.

programme.title: Pasión Capítulo 9
programme.desc: Semanas después Don Timoteo y Camila se casan. Epifanio le cuenta a Mercedes de la boda y ella le escribe a Ricardo. Alberto le pregunta a Manuela quién es el amante de Úrsula. Ricardo va a ver a Mercedes y le cuenta que Timoteo se casó con una Camila.

programme.title: Pasión Capítulo 10
programme.desc: Ricardo visita a Timoteo para asegurarse de que la herencia de Lisabeta haya quedado intacta y conocer a su esposa. Justo le pregunta directo a Ofelia si Santiago es hijo de Don Jorge. Don Jorge le dice a Úrsula que le buscará esposo. Timoteo fallece.

programme.title: Esmeralda Capítulo 17
programme.desc: Crisanta confronta a Dominga y le pregunta si Esmeralda es aquella niña que nació muerta. Adrián le confiesa a su padre que está enamorado de Graciela. José Armando le cuenta a su madre sobre los planes de devolverle la vista a Esmeralda.

programme.title: Esmeralda Capítulo 18
programme.desc: Graciela, muy agobiada, visita a Adrián en el hospital. Fátima se preocupa por la cercanía entre Adrián y Graciela. Rodolfo se niega a aceptar que José Armando se case con alguien más que no sea Graciela.

programme.title: Esmeralda Capítulo 19
programme.desc: Dominga presiona a Crisanta para que diga la verdad sobre el origen de Esmeralda y así poderla librar de Lucio. Rodolfo amenaza con desaparecer a Esmeralda si no se mantiene alejada de su hijo.

programme.title: Esmeralda Capítulo 20
programme.desc: Lucio asegura que Esmeralda le pertenece por haberle salvado la vida tiempo atrás. Blanca le cuenta a José Armando que Rodolfo los vigila de cerca a él y Esmeralda. José Armando se empeña en ayudar a Esmeralda a recuperar la vista.

programme.title: Esmeralda Capítulo 21
programme.desc: José Armando no permite que Fátima lo acompañe a la ciudad y ésta se va con Esmeralda. El Dr. Lucio enfurece cuando sabe que Esmeralda fue a la ciudad. Adrián no está dispuesto a renunciar a su amor por Graciela. Esmeralda tiene posibilidades de ver.

programme.title: Mañana Es Para Siempre Capítulo 133
programme.desc: Erika lleva a cabo los preparativos de su boda con Eduardo. Eduardo le cuenta a Fernanda que Artemio quiere deshacerse de los Elizalde. Bárbara se molesta al saber que Gonzalo ha decidido que el hijo de Aníbal sea su nuevo heredero.
