programme.title: The Time of Patience to Become a Masterpiece: Floor Carving <53>
programme.desc: This video captures the floor carving process of the inkstone master. Experience the persistent and tenacious inkstone-making process of the master through this ASMR video.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Overcoming Time of Patience: Selecting Hairs <52>
programme.desc: In the traditional brush-making process, the process of selecting hairs, known as 'Jeongmo work,' is essential for creating a quality brush. Let's appreciate the artisan enduring the time of patience through thousands of repetitions.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Craftsman of Wind: Fan Master <44>
programme.desc: A Fan Master is an artisan who makes traditional fans. Especially, folding fans made by combining the outer layers of bamboo are considered high-quality fans. Appreciate the beauty of traditional fans imbued with the dedication and skill of the Fan Master.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Autumn Night, Sound of Light: Muju Anseong Nakhwa Play <16>
programme.desc: Muju Anseong Nakhwa Play is named because the sparks falling along the line resemble flowers and is designated as an intangible cultural heritage traditional play.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Palace in the Rain: Gyeongbokgung <29>
programme.desc: Inviting you to Gyeongbokgung Palace on a rainy day. The raindrops falling on the gray slate of the palace flow down the slate, creating beautiful sounds.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Beauty of Golden Patterns. Gold Leaf Master <21>
programme.desc: The technique of gold leaf, which enhances the beauty and elegance of Korean clothing, is a traditional art where thin gold leaves are applied to fabric to add beauty.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Peaceful Mudflats: The Vast Mudflats at Sunset, Suncheon Bay <8>
programme.desc: Located on the southern coast, Suncheon Bay features stunning reed fields and Salicornia (glasswort) colonies. It is home to diverse tidal flat creatures and rare birds like the black-faced spoonbill.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Mystical Hidden Scenery: Jusanji Pond, Cheongsong EP.2 <10>
programme.desc: Completed in 1720, Jusanji Pond is fed by clear waters from Byeolbawi Rock and surrounded by lush forests of Juwangsan Mountain, creating a serene, otherworldly atmosphere.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Autumn Forest of the Royal Tombs: With King Sejo's Regret, Gwangneung <17>
programme.desc: The resting place of King Sejo and Queen Jeonghui, Gwangneung Forest in Namyangju covers an expansive area of 11 square kilometers, boasting ecological stability and species diversity. Enjoy a walk through its scenic forest paths.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Hand Skills of Joseon Artisans: Hat Making Master <77>
programme.desc: The tanggeon, a horsehair hat once worn under the gat, reflected dignity in the daily lives of Joseon men. Densely woven by skilled hands, it reveals the calm elegance and restraint found in traditional craftsmanship.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Exquisite Details of Joseon: Traditional Headwear <61>
programme.desc: With threads finer than hair, artisans weave traditional headgear that once reflected dignity and etiquette. Manggeon and Tanggeon, more than mere accessories, embody the refined aesthetic of Joseon craftsmanship.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Secret of Hanji that Lasts a Thousand Years: Stripping Mulberry Bark <54>
programme.desc: Traditional Hanji possesses excellent value, enduring for a thousand years without changing. Let’s appreciate the process of stripping the bark from mulberry trees, the main raw material in the creation of traditional Hanji.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Carrying on Korea’s Archery Tradition: Bow and Arrow Making Master <93>
programme.desc: Bamboo, horn, sinew, and wood come together to form a traditional bow and arrow. Each material is carefully shaped through countless steps, preserving Korea’s long archery tradition. Listen to the rhythm of carving and polishing.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Blooming from Paper: Traditional Jihwa <58>
programme.desc: Cut, folded, and twisted into bloom, these paper flowers hold layers of sincerity and hope. Once adorning palaces and sacred spaces, jihwa blossoms again in the hands of devoted artisans. Let the soft rustle of paper whisper the timeless breath of tradition.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Sound of Bamboo Forest: Chaesangjang Master <56>
programme.desc: Chaesangjang is artisans who dye thinly sliced bamboo bark in colorful hues and weave them into various geometric patterns to make baskets and other items. Let’s appreciate the process of weaving dyed bamboo strips by a master of Chaesangjang.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Dyeing in Royal Red: Red Dyeing Master <70>
programme.desc: The Great Red Color, once a royal hue, is drawn from blossoms through repeated extraction and careful dyeing. Each layer of color deepens through the artisan’s steady hands, preserving a legacy of elegance and tradition.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Painting Enlightenment: Zen Painting <74>
programme.desc: A single brushstroke carries the breath of meditation and the clarity of awakening. Zen painting transcends words, capturing insight and stillness through the silent movement of ink.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: A Master’s Touch: Beating and Stitching Fabric <85>
programme.desc: From selecting fabric to quiet stitching, every step in traditional quilting reflects careful devotion. Through rhythmic beating and fine needlework, practical craft meets gentle beauty.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Making Flower Shoes: The Art of Hand-Stitching <81>
programme.desc: A single pair of flower shoes holds hours of stitching and dedication. Threading the needle again and again, artisans create footwear that is both delicate and elegant. Sense the quiet patterns of tradition in every step.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Subtle Fragrance: Tea Making <12>
programme.desc: In the early morning on the slopes of Jirisan, grandmothers pick wild tea leaves among the pine trees. Experience the subtle fragrance of traditional tea making.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Creating a Four-Legged Table: Wooden Furniture Master <49>
programme.desc: Carpenters are artisans who make windows, woodenware, and wooden furniture. They continue the traditional woodworking techniques, creating works like the Sabangtakja (four-sided table). Appreciate the works of Carpenters.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Secret of Hanji that Lasts a Thousand Years: Stripping Mulberry Bark <54>
programme.desc: Traditional Hanji possesses excellent value, enduring for a thousand years without changing. Let’s appreciate the process of stripping the bark from mulberry trees, the main raw material in the creation of traditional Hanji.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Beauty of Golden Patterns. Gold Leaf Master <21>
programme.desc: The technique of gold leaf, which enhances the beauty and elegance of Korean clothing, is a traditional art where thin gold leaves are applied to fabric to add beauty.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Masterpieces Created by Time: Ink (Meok) <51>
programme.desc: Ink (Meok) has been one of the Four Treasures of the Study (ink, paper, brush, inkstone) and a companion of scholars since ancient times. Welcome to the world of ink, masterpieces created by time(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Creating Folding Screens: Pasting Master <41>
programme.desc: Baechup is the traditional Korean technique for mounting calligraphy and paintings to enhance their preservation and beauty. Appreciate the master's craftmanship as he create a traditional ten-panel folding screen.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Emprendiendo sueños
programme.desc: Dos hermanas convirtieron una deliciosa receta de su madre en un gran negocio. Un hombre pasó de ser astronauta a cultivar las mejores uvas para hacer vino.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Frontera olvidada
programme.desc: Miles de migrantes quieren pasar a la frontera para ir a Panamá, buscan la manera de llegar a Estados Unidos a pesar de los peligros que tienen que enfrentar.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Entre Dios y el narco
programme.desc: Sacerdotes y pastores en ambos lados de la frontera tienen que enfrentar las agresiones de los cárteles de la droga, ellos cuentan los ataques a sus iglesias y albergues, algunos llevan armas de fuego bajo sus sotanas.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - En nombre del hijo
programme.desc: Una madre decide hacer lo que sea para vengar la muerte de su hijo sin pensar en las consecuencias que eso podría ocasionar.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - La muerte del gurú
programme.desc: La muerte de un gurú ha generado misterio y dudas entre sus seguidores. Solo cuatro personas sobrevivieron a la tragedia del vuelo 965 y aún lidian con el dolor y el trauma.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Persecución mortal
programme.desc: Un accidente automovilístico dejó a un conductor luchando horas por su vida y su madre descubrio que agentes de la patrulla fronteriza estuvieron involucrados en la persecución.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Justicia imperfecta
programme.desc: Una madre recibió más de cuatro millones de dólares como indemnización por la muerte de su hijo, pero para ella eso no era suficiente y decidió vengar su muerte a pesar de que eso podría llevarla a prisión.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Víctimas de la justicia
programme.desc: Una batalla legal que se extendió por años, el fiscal general de México sufrió una derrota en un caso muy importante para él. Mauro Castillo habla sobre su participación en la película 'Encanto'.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Buscando gloria
programme.desc: Una joven recuerda con dolor la historia que cambió su vida durante su carrera de boxeadora. Sofía Ramos habla sobre su sueño de ser una gran atleta y cómo volvió su sueño realidad.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Asesinos en serie
programme.desc: En sus vecindarios los consideraban ciudadanos ejemplares, pero todo resultó ser una farsa y ahora todos dudan de la bondad que aparentaba, una pareja muy peligrosa.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Desaparecidas
programme.desc: Monterrey, un lugar con muchas mujeres desaparecidas, jóvenes que salieron de sus casas y no volvieron, ahora sus padres están desconsolados y en busca de justicia.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Habla El Papa
programme.desc: En una entrevista el Papa Francisco da un regalo a los mexicanos con una charla amena donde fija la postura de la iglesia católica ante diferentes temas como la migración.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Mgsr. Romero
programme.desc: Monseñor Oscar Romero es mostrado como el hombre de la iglesia de los pobres, se le dio el calificativo de Romero Mártir por lo que se puede ser beatificado sin la necesidad de haber hecho un milagro.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - En cuerpo Ajeno
programme.desc: Desde una sobrecargo hasta una mariachi narran su experiencia en una vida donde no sabe quienes son. Personas transgénero que han nacido atrapados en un cuerpo que no es el suyo.

programme.title: Dinamita Kid
programme.desc: Dinamita Kid quiere ajustar cuentas con su enemigo El Huracan López en el ring por haberle quitado a su novia en el pasado. Un gángster intenta comprar al boxeador para que pierda la contienda contra El Huracán.

programme.desc: El doctor Pablo está por contraer matrimonio con Mini pero su adicción a las mujeres lo lleva a tomar la personalidad de su amigo Ricardo y así comprometerse en una aventura amorosa con África.

programme.title: Lágrimas de amor
programme.desc: El viejo y viudo Carlos está obsesionado con la vedette Marga, quien lo confunde con el gerente del banco donde el hombre ha trabajado toda la vida. Junto con su amante Jorge, buscarán explotarlo.

programme.title: El jinete solitario en el valle de los desaparecidos
programme.desc: Unos bandoleros que se dedican a trabajar minas de manera clandestina, raptan a Don Rosendo, quien ha encontrado una mina de un metal muy valioso. 'El jinete solitario' ayuda a Don Rosendo y a Rosita, capturando a los bandoleros.

programme.title: Dinamita Kid
programme.desc: Dinamita Kid quiere ajustar cuentas con su enemigo El Huracan López en el ring por haberle quitado a su novia en el pasado. Un gángster intenta comprar al boxeador para que pierda la contienda contra El Huracán.

programme.title: Virgen que forjó una patria

programme.title: Pata de palo
programme.desc: Teresa es la nieta de Don Cástulo, un hombre ferrocarrilero a quien culpan de un accidente de trenes por estar ebrio. Aurelio quiere casarse con Teresa a cambio de no delatar a su abuelo. Manolo, hermano de Teresa y ella desenmascaran a Aurelio.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Donde mores, no enamores'
programme.desc: La visita de un joven a casa de su mejor amigo provoca que surjan diversos sentimientos entre él, la madre y las hermanas de su amigo. Las cosas se complican cuando el amigo del joven descubre la verdad y su vida corre peligro.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Quien de tu mal no te advierte, mal te quiere'
programme.desc: Un joven sueña con ser DJ, pero debe lidiar con la extrema disciplina de su abuelo, quien quedó a cargo de él después de la muerte de sus padres. El joven y su abuelo tendrán que aprender a convivir respetando sus diferencias.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Del fuego te guardarás, pero del malvado no podrás'
programme.desc: Una joven queda embarazada y al buscar ayuda con la doctora de la escuela cae en manos de un traficante de órganos, por lo que su vida estará en peligro.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'El buen morir es el premio al buen vivir'
programme.desc: Un pequeño está decidido a demostrarle a su hermano el gran amor que siente por él, pues sabe que él padece una terrible enfermedad.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'A la vejez y a la juventud les espera el ataúd'
programme.desc: Un joven pasa por momentos difíciles tras la muerte de su abuela, pero con la ayuda de sus seres amados logrará salir adelante.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Es bueno el uso, pero no el abuso'
programme.desc: Un hombre se aprovecha de la confianza de una joven para robar sus diseños, ella decide defender su dignidad y luchar por lo que le pertenece.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Mío, dice el gato, por ver si le diesen algo'
programme.desc: Beto, un estudiante apasionado por el teatro, estará dispuesto a hacer todo lo necesario para alcanzar sus sueños, y aunque no será fácil, tendrá que superar la adversidad con el apoyo de su familia.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'La desgracia del obrero, está en el líder logrero'
programme.desc: Una joven decide ayudar a mujeres que trabajan en malas condiciones para que sus derechos sean respetados.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Más vale regaño que duela, que llanto que dure'
programme.desc: Una joven tiene conflictos con su mamá por su mala conducta y decide irse a vivir con su papá.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Cuando la burra es mañosa, aunque la carguen de santos'
programme.desc: Un chico comete algunos errores en el pasado y ahora trata de hacer bien las cosas; aunque necesita apoyo para no reincidir. Discriminar a alguien por sus fallas pasadas, puede provocar que muchas personas no puedan rehacer su vida.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'El que no se arriesga no cruza el río'
programme.desc: Una joven queda parapléjica en un accidente, por lo que su padre la mantiene encerrada. Gracias a su terapeuta y un chico interesado en ella, la joven se atreverá salir al mundo para hacer cosas nuevas.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'A amor mal correspondido, ausencia y olvido'
programme.desc: Una joven tiene una relación con un hombre casado a pesar de que su padre y su amiga se oponen. Poco a poco la joven se va dando cuenta de las falsas promesas de su amante y comienza a aprender que no debe depender de nadie.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'La salud no tiene precio y el que la arriesga es un necio'
programme.desc: Una madre primeriza decide hacerle caso a su amiga y no vacunar a su hijo, pues cree que puede ser contraproducente para el bebé, sin saber que su decisión pondrá en riesgo la salud del pequeño.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Es bueno el uso, pero no el abuso'
programme.desc: Un hombre se aprovecha de la confianza de una joven para robar sus diseños, ella decide defender su dignidad y luchar por lo que le pertenece.

programme.title: Una Familia de Diez - La familia pequeña vive mejor
programme.desc: Una nueva norma del edificio dicta que cada departamento deberá tener un máximo de cinco miembros por familia, ¿qué hará la familia López?

programme.title: Una Familia de Diez - El nombre de la brosa
programme.desc: Victoria tiene que escribir el nombre de todos los miembros de su familia, ¿sabrá cuál es el verdadero nombre de la nena?

programme.title: Una familia de diez - Que bonita familia
programme.desc: Plácido tiene un mal día y se preocupa mucho cuando Plutarco le confiesa que se casó con la hija de su jefe porque está embarazada.

programme.title: Una familia de diez - Un fantasma de diez
programme.desc: Doña Romina escucha ruidos extraños en el departamento donde murió don Genaro el mes pasado. Averigua si de verdad hay un fantasma entre la familia.

programme.title: Una familia de diez - El exorcismo de Martini Rouse
programme.desc: Martina comienza a actuar raro y la familia cree que está poseída. Mientras que Justito trata de demostrar que sabe jugar béisbol, Victoria quiere entrar a equipo a pesar de que el entrenador no se lo permite por ser mujer.

programme.title: Una Familia de Diez - El bebé de Rosegaby
programme.desc: Plácido por fin está en su casa, pero todas las noches sueña con que su jefe regresa por él. Además, ¿el gusanitito estará poseído?

programme.title: María de Todos Los Ángeles - La casa de los sustos
programme.desc: Doña Lucha obliga a sus hijos a seguir la tradición familiar de vender huevos de harina en la feria. María cree que Albertano la va a dejar si no le da una prueba de amor y decide llevarlo a la casa de los sustos para pasar el tiempo solos.

programme.title: María de Todos Los Ángeles - La noche de la langosta
programme.desc: María quiere tener una cena romántica con Albertano pero los vecinos no los dejan porque quieren ver la final del fútbol.

programme.title: María de Todos Los Ángeles - El rap de Doña Juana
programme.desc: El gato de Doña Juana parece estar muerto y Doña Lucha tiene que darle la triste noticia.

programme.title: María de Todos Los Ángeles - Una luz al fondo del tinaco
programme.desc: María de Todos los Ángeles queda atrapada en el tinaco y su espíritu va hacia la luz.

programme.title: María de Todos Los Ángeles - San Hipoclorito Arcángel
programme.desc: Han pasado 3 años desde que María de Todos los Ángeles se ahogó en el fondo del tinaco y Doña Lucha quiere canonizar el burro de planchar donde supuestamente María dejó impresa la imagen de San Hipoclorito Arcángel.

programme.title: María de Todos Los Ángeles - Hazlo con ella
programme.desc: Gracias a una película, Albertano descubre una manera poco inusual de sacar a María del coma. Albertano con la ayuda de Betzabé trata de poner en marcha su plan, pero es interrumpido por Doña Lucha y Carmelo.

programme.title: Nosotros Los Guapos Capítulo 6
programme.desc: Rosita les dice a Albertano y el Vítor que la ahijada de doña Cuca va a cumplir quince años y necesita unos chambelanes para la fiesta. El Vítor y Albertano le ofrecen sus servicios de chambelanes.

programme.title: Nosotros Los Guapos Capítulo 7
programme.desc: El Huevo les propone a Albertano y el Vítor para que se vayan a trabajar de ilegales a los Estados Unidos. El Huevo les da al Vítor y Albertano unas pastillas para dormir y les hace creer que los llevó a Estados Unidos.

programme.title: Nosotros Los Guapos Capítulo 8
programme.desc: Albertano y el Vítor se meten a la grabación de una telenovela, el director cree que son actores y ellos aprovechan para comer en el catering. Albertano y el Vítor provocan que la actriz de la telenovela tenga un accidente y son despedidos.

programme.title: Nosotros Los Guapos Capítulo 9
programme.desc: Albertano y el Vítor encuentran a un bebé abandonado en la entrada de su casa, Rosita encuentra en el bambineto una nota de la madre diciendo que deja a su hijo para que el papá se haga cargo de él, pero no dice el nombre del padre.

programme.title: Nosotros Los Guapos Capítulo 10
programme.desc: El Vítor y Albertano despiertan a doña Cuca con las mañanitas y ella se asusta mucho al escucharlos cantar. Albertano y el Vítor le dicen a doña Cuca que se gastaron el dinero de la renta en una fiesta de cumpleaños para ella.

programme.title: Nosotros Los Guapos Capítulo 11

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 94

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 95

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 98

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 99

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 101

programme.desc: José no va a su boda y le causa un ataque al padre de la novia, ahora quiere destruir unos óvulos congelados. Adriana se entera de que su hijo murió en un accidente, reclama que le hayan mentido.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Candy ofrece alojamiento a cambio de sexo, pero su inquilino quiere terminar el contrato. Su hija adoptiva busca al padre biológico, al reencontrarse, él la viola, embaraza y asesina.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Zuky le exige a Johan 30 mil dólares, él la contrató para un video y le mordió una nalga. Un stripper pide indemnización porque en una despedida de soltera le desgarraron los testículos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La hija de Daniel y Ray nació con problemas motores porque el cordón umbilical se enredó en su cuello y le provocó una falta de oxígeno en el cerebro. Ahora la madre la sobreprotege y el padre quiere que haga una vida normal y se prepare para el futuro. Alejandro quiere desalojar a Débora de la casa de su mamá para venderla y darle la mitad a su hermano, quien fue violentamente golpeado cuando se descubrió que tenía una relación con su padrastro.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Nally acusa al guardia de seguridad, Osiris, de haber permitido el crimen de su esposo. Indra fue detenida en su cita de inmigración por portar un arma, ella jura que no sabía que la tenía.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: José Luis se venga de Rosario quien de joven lo violó con un palo de billar, él le hizo lo mismo. Cinthya denuncia a su cuñado y al padre de este por el abuso continuado y muerte de su hermana.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Víctor ha estado preso y ahora quiere confesar un crimen, pero su esposa se opone, asegura que él es inocente. Nathalie es perseguida por la mafia rusa porque la confunden con su amiga Valery.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Deborah le regala un restaurante a Alejandro y ahora se lo quiere quitar, pero él lo perdió. Además, la hija de Gabriel y Paola es una niña muy delgada, solo come verduras y mira las calorías.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Nicolás consume salvia como droga, sus efectos alucinógenos son potentes, su esposa le pide el divorcio. Yohaly y Marianela se disputan 350 mil dólares de herencia, pero no hay testamento.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Eduardo tiene hijos, esposa y amante, en una festividad se vieron todos y acabó mal. En otro caso, Carlos y Katiuska descubrieron que Ámbar, la niñera de su hijo, es una ex drogadicta.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Jesús quiere la custodia compartida de su hija, pero Sandra, la madre, se niega rotundamente. En otro caso, Yadira es una mujer madura que tiene sexo con el joven Adrián, él se obsesiona.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La familia de un hombre niega que haya sido homosexual y pelea por su herencia con la pareja gay del difunto. Irving descubre que el hijo de su esposa no es suyo y quiere anular el matrimonio.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Jésica sufre de anorgasmia y buscó ayuda en Cornelio, que ofrece servicios cuestionables de meditación orgásmica. Ángel y Patricia se separaron y ambos reclaman ser dueños de una coreografía.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ana pone la casa a nombre de su hijo para que demuestre solvencia económica, ahora él quiere desalojarla y ella lo demanda. Jorge exige que su pareja lo deje ser el padre adoptivo de su hija.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victoria y Danilo se besan, y ella no sospecha que se está enamorando de Aurelio Casillas. Ambos confiesan sentirse atraídos el uno por el otro. Mónica confirma su embarazo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica quiere sorprender a Aurelio con su embarazo, pero se lo encuentra en la cama con Victoria. Se hace pasar por su hermana y, a solas, jura no perdonarlo si él se enamora de otra.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victoria sube en las encuestas y eso preocupa a Elsa, quien, en un intento desesperado por ganar votantes, le propone a Max cerrar Villa Catalina. El Chema comienza a interesarse en Rutila.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Elsa visita a Victoria y le propone una tregua para trabajar juntas contra el narcotráfico. Max está dispuesto a perder el juicio de Ximena para demostrar con quién está su fidelidad.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema ordena la emboscada para recuperar al hijo de Matilde; cuando ella se arrepiente, ya es demasiado tarde. Mientras trata de escapar con sus nietos, doña Alba es brutalmente herida.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Doña Alba es sometida a una cirugía, ha perdido mucha sangre y se debate entre la vida y la muerte. Aurelio sospecha que Matilde y el Chema están detrás. Ximena es condenada a prisión.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio averigua quién es en verdad el escolta de Matilde, y le dice que se despida de su hijo. Los Casillas le declaran la guerra al Chema, y averiguan dónde se esconden sus hombres.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Matilde trata de reconciliarse con Chacorta, pero ya tiene los minutos contados: él no le perdona la traición. Lo importante ahora para los Casillas es hacer pagar al Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ximena se enfrenta en la cárcel a otras presas que la provocan, y se descubre que ella es la viuda del Señor de los Cielos. A petición de Rutila, Aurelio acepta reunirse con Santiago.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Luego de un enfrentamiento en el hospital, rodean a Leonor y Ramos, quienes tienen que dejar escapar a Heriberto. Para probar su lealtad al Chema, Ernesto mata a uno de los hombres de Chacorta.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema escapa de la cárcel con ayuda de Tijeras. Sin saberlo, Elsa firma los papeles que garantizan la fuga. Ella y Victoria siguen adelante con sus campañas por el Gobierno de Jalisco.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El padre Lázaro no puede con la presión: quiere hablar con el obispo. Ernesto le pide a Chacorta que le dé un susto. Finalmente, en la casa de Danilo, Victoria y Aurelio se conocen.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los hombres de Chacorta descubren que el padre Lázaro iba a hablar con Garnica, y lo silencian; no dejan cabos sueltos. Por recuperar a su hijo, Matilde está decidida a entregar a Chacorta.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: A Matilde le tortura la idea de no volver a ver a su hijo, y el Chema le sugiere que lo secuestre. Leonor desconfía del suicidio del padre Lázaro: le pide a Garnica que presione a los Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victoria y Danilo se besan, y ella no sospecha que se está enamorando de Aurelio Casillas. Ambos confiesan sentirse atraídos el uno por el otro. Mónica confirma su embarazo.

programme.title: The Boda Boda Thieves
programme.desc: The Boda Boda Thieves deals with the theme of corruption and the tension between traditional communal values pitted against the prevalent ideology of “dog eat dog” individualism. The film is an African homage and tribute to the great Italian Neo-realist film “The Bicycle Thief” (1948) directed by Vittorio de Sica. We must stress that this is definitely not a remake and that “The Boda Boda Thieves” is an original work that is freely inspired by the great classic. We use the classic as an armature and work to emulate the focus and kinetic simplicity of the original. This is another Yes! That’s Us film and as such we stayed true to our working method of using a small mobile crew of multitasking people. Uganda has received a lot of bad press lately due to a raft of repressive laws against homosexuality, freedom of expression and even miniskirts. Not all Ugandan’s have fallen for these cheap political stunts and many see these outrages for what they are: smokescreens to draw public scrutiny away from the real problem of government kleptocracy. This film examines the issue of crime and corruption, the generation gap and the cult of machismo. As artists we believe in the power of cinema to mirror society for all its imperfect beauty. Slowly but surely positive changes are happening. Despite hardships the people endure they find new ways to make things work. We believe that The Boda Boda Thieves makes commentary on a society in transition.

programme.title: Biblical Collectors Series

Some scholars believe the Bible tells us there will be a mysterious event called 'The Rapture'. Many believe in the 'second coming' of Christ. Will there be a 'third' coming as well? Could there be a formula hidden in the Book of Revelation? The answers are at once hopeful and frightening.

programme.title: Birth of Christianity

And why was it that Christians refused to create a separate religion? Why, in the year 150, did Christianity declare itself to be 'verus Israel?', 'the real Israel' What were the consequences for the Jews?

programme.title: End Time Prophecy of the Popes

In this he foretold the end of the papacy, the destruction of Rome, and the Last Judgment. Is this only one more apocalyptic vision? Another 'end of the world' tale like the one people have imagined in the Mayan calendar? Perhaps not.

programme.title: Biblical Prophecy of John - End Times Revelation & Message to the 7 Churches
programme.desc: John's letters to the Seven Churches, written while he was in exile on Patmos, were messages from Jesus to seven churches in Asia Minor. programme.desc: In a The Doctors Exclusive: Gloria Gaynor’s major spine surgery. Gloria and her surgeon, Dr. Hooman Melamed explains the risky procedure. Tips to protect your family this flu season! The surprising germy spots in your kitchen!

programme.title: Fighting in Front of Your Children
programme.desc: Spouses exploding at one another openly at home. Who’s victorious in these battles? No one… Children pay the price. Can Dr. Phil teach self-control to these impulsive mothers and fathers? And what are the long-term effects? Meet adults whose parents fought constantly in front of them, and how it impacted their lives. Insecurity, low self-esteem, and loneliness are only some of the many issues Dr. Phil brings to light. Join Dr. Phil as he shows the before and after of parental confrontations.

programme.title: Sexy Too Soon
programme.desc: At an age when most girls are passing notes in class and playing tag on the playground, the girls in today’s show are concerned with sex appeal and lingerie! You’ll meet two “preteens” who, in Dr. Phil’s opinion, are dressing too sexy for their age. In addition, Dr. Phil visits a 12-year-old’s website that features her doing a variety of daily tasks…in a bikini! Her mom thinks it’s a good way for her to earn money for college and build self-esteem. Dr. Phil examines what’s “appropriate” and what’s not, and what do to when your daughter dresses way too “hot.”

programme.title: The Newlywed Show
programme.desc: Statistics say that one out of every two marriages ends in divorce, but you can beat the odds. Dr. Phil spells out the cold hard facts of making a marriage work. We’ll meet a wife who realized soon after her wedding that her husband was not the prince charming she expected. Are there serious problems here or is she just sweating the small stuff? Also, a newlywed couple with a baby finds it hard to spend romantic time together. Dr. Phil shows them how nurturing a marriage is essential and needs to be a priority for the sake of the children.

programme.desc: Roadways can be a wild place. With violent road rage incidents increasing 500% over the last decade, 'road raging' is a human behavior that has become widely known. The bad driving phenomenon hasn't helped either-- in fact it's said that 80% of all accidents are caused by 20% of drivers. "Road Wars" takes a deep dive into American roadways, examining extreme human behavior, wild weather, insane accidents and a few welcomed instances of acts of kindness.

programme.title: I Want You to Want Me
programme.desc: In the Big City, true love is increasingly hard to achieve. But what if brave souls, yearning for romance and a loving partnership, agree to a provocative proposal: getting married at first sight? This groundbreaking format offers a shockingly novel twist on the relationship, dating and wedding space. Four experts - a therapist, anthropologist, spiritualist and clinical psychologist - will create what they believe are three perfect couples. The twist is that these couples will never meet or know each other until they walk down the aisle and see each other face to face - for the first time - at the altar. Each self-contained episode will track classic lifestyle stories of newlyweds: the honeymoon; early nesting; meeting the in-laws; and other universally relatable events of married life. Will they remain together in the end, or decide to separate?

programme.title: Judgment Days
programme.desc: In ARRANGED, three couples from different cultural backgrounds have one thing in common-- the belief in arranged marriages. From a Romani gypsy couple in New York City, to a southern couple from the Bible belt, to a couple raised by traditional Eastern Indian parents living in Los Angeles-- these brides and grooms don't just marry each other, their unions include their entire family. Viewers will see each couple's relationship from the lead-up to their weddings to the several months after the reality of married life sinks in.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the first time ever TAPS comes to the aid of a priest whose home is a source of unexplained activity. Both Reverend Jennings and her parishioners have heard footsteps in the hall ways, the sounds of crying children and have seen objects moving by themselves. An unusual mark scorched into her bedroom floor baffles the team.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to the infamous town of Salem, MA for a pair of baffling cases to uncover what vengeful spirits might still roam this site of centuries-old witch trials and executions. The Lyceum Restaurant was formerly the home of Bridget Bishop, the first woman in Salem executed for suspected witchcraft. Witnesses report frequently seeing the apparition of a woman dressed in period clothing.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS revealsinvestigation highlights and startling evidence captured during the six hour live broadcast from The Waverly Hills Sanatorium. WhenTAPS, along ECW wrestlerElijah Burke,made a return trip to thehospital,nothing could prepare them for what they found.During the investigation Jason and Grant attemptto communicate with the spirit of a young boy who roamsthe halls.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the first time ever, TAPS sits down with Destination Truth's Josh Gates for an in-depth discussion with TAPS. Jason and Grant will discuss how TAPS came to be and will provide insight and answers to the most chilling and baffling cases. They will talk about their favorite investigations and delve into some hot button issues - like Steve's biggest fears. Then the team takes time to answer important questions from viewers.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In the first episode of a brand new season of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to the historic battle field of Ft. Mifflin to uncover the truth behind some ghostly claims. Ft. Mifflin was once the site of bloody battles in both Revolutionary and Civil Wars. Today, visitors and employees tell chilling tales of their brushes with the afterlife. Some claim to have seen apparitions of soldiers, while others report hearing a woman's terrified scream coming from an empty room.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: An urgent call from Dave Tango's father sets the scene for the next case. William Tango, an ex-cop and amateur ghost hunter, was baffled by unexplainable events he experienced on a recent trip to the Burlington County Prison in Mt. Holly, New Jersey. The TAPS team soon discovers William is not alone. Once the site of numerous executions, the prison maintains an unmistakable feeling of dread.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the past nine years unexplainable sounds at the Clapp Library have put Jacques, the night custodian, on edge. The unmistakable sound of books sliding off of shelves and dark shadows moving through the stacks are just some of the eerie events plaguing the library. Desperate to prove to other employees that he's not going crazy, Jacque calls in TAPS to find some answers. During the investigation Jason and Grant hear a strange sound coming from the balcony area.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week the TAPS team heads to the historic Confederate campgrounds of the Cashtown Inn. This old hotel was once the crossroad for Confederate troops on their way to the battle of Gettysburg. The basement of the hotel was later used as a makeshift triage unit, where injured soldiers were often subject to barbaric and crude amputations. Today, hotel guests report countless bizarre experiences, from unexplained sounds in the middle of the night to apparitions roaming the hotel.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Plumbers, Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson moonlight as Ghost Hunters, leading an intrepid team called T.A.P.S. (The Atlantic Paranormal Society) through investigations of churches, inns and infamous jails.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, when overwhelming reports of paranormal activity plague the Wright - Patterson Air Force Base, TAPS gets enlisted to help the military. For the past ten years, the air force base has been host to strange experiences. Recent renovations at the base have resulted in escalating activity. At the Arnold House, personnel have reported hearing children's voices and footsteps walking up the stairs. And, in Building 70, ghostly apparitions have put everyone on edge.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS heads to the Mt. Washington Hotel in New Hampshire to be the first paranormal group to investigate this legendary resort. The expansive property sits on top of a massive limestone deposit, known to be a catalyst for paranormal activity. The caretakers here have experienced everything from doors that open and close by themselves to full body apparitions.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode, TAPS saddles up and heads west to investigate the legendary Goldfield Hotel in Goldfield, Nevada. This hotel from a bygone era is host to several stories of murder and tragedy. The horrific story of Elizabeth, a woman who was chained to radiator and left for dead, has left many to believe her troubled spirit still haunts the halls. While investigating the second floor, Jason and Grant pursue a solid black mass darting through doorways.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today is all about feeding a large crowd, and Lidia cooks up recipes that all your guests will love, no matter whom you are hosting - Sausages and Apples, a flavorful one-pot meal that is great for family-style dining; Spaghetti with Roasted Garlic Pesto, a delicious and economical addition to any party; and finally, Chocolate Ricotta Cheesecake, a chocolatey twist to the classic Italian ricotta cheesecake.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Everyone loves pasta, and today Lidia shows you the fun and economical way to make all your friends and family happy at the dinner table with a pasta party. On the menu is Spaghetti with Anchovies and Breadcrumbs, a delicious Southern Italian favorite; a Pasta Chinja - a heart-warming Baked Pasta with Tomato Sauce, Meatballs and Egg. Finally, Lidia will share her Fusilli with Roasted Tomato Pesto - a complex bowl of pasta that will become a staple in your house.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There is nothing like a warm oven that makes guests feel invited in a kitchen. The heat and the aromas permeate and bring smiles to everyone's faces. In this episode, Lidia shares three of her favorite oven baked dishes. Eggplant and Rice Parmigiana, Vegetable and Meat Casserole, Bread Puddign with Pears.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia constantly cherishes the memory of baking bread with her Grandma Rosa. As simple as it was, there is nothing that could take away how powerful this culinary experience was for her. Lidia starts off with a quick and easy Onion Tomato Focaccia, and then talks about Taralli, crunchy little bread rings that are a treat in southern Italy. She then makes Pizza Rolls with two uniquely Italian fillings- broccoli rabe and sausage, and ricotta and leeks.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fettuccine with caramelized onions, bacon and olives; orange spritz; roast chicken with rosemary and lemon.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Grilled lamb chops are always delicious but n this episode, Ldiia sears them in a heavy skillet, pressing them down so that all the surface get crisp. She serves the chops with a simple yet elegant red wine sauce with dried cherries, garlic and bay leaves and rosemary. Served with a Tasty Potato Salad and finished with beautiful Almond and Coffee Cream Mini Tarts, this is a meal that everyone will love!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia believes in cooking according to season, and when springtime comes, she and her family all work well to create a beautiful garden. In this episode, she shares four delicious recipes that celebrate the bounty of the summertime garden. Tuna Salad with Boiled Zucchini, String Bean Salad with Capers and Basil, Whole Wheat Cous with Cucumbers, and finally Shells with Chicken and Zucchini.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's all about the balance today as Lidia pairs some unexpected ingredients that result in the best of flavors. She starts the meal with her Prosciutto and Fig Bruschetta: grilled bread topped with a salty sweet combination of prosciutto and fig jam; Spaghetti with Fennel and Bitter Greens: spaghetti tossed with fennel, escarole and a splash of balsamic; Chocolate Anise Biscotti: the "twice cooked" Italian cookie made with chocolate and anise.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Celebrating the late-summer harvest with oat risotto with butternut squash and sunchokes; stuffed mushrooms; one-bowl olive oil cake and red wine poached pears.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There is nothing like pasta to bring the Lidia's family to the table. In this episode Lidia shares some of her favorite pasta dishes including a comforting Baked Rigatoni with Zucchini , a delicious Penne with Ricotta and Mushrooms and one of her personal favorites, Fettuccine with a Clam and Leek Sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Bergamot and ricotta parfait with nougatine and toasted almonds; almond tart; chocolate anise biscotti.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia introduces this episode with "Beautiful vegetables and a hot oven: a great marriage!" She then begins the meal with a simple and refreshing Sesame and Fava Bean Dip, perfect for flatbreads. Next, she prepares a Baked Eggplant Stuffed with Meat and Vegetables, topped with a golden, cheesy crust. Her unique version of Baked Potatoes is made with Pancetta and Oregano.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today is a celebration of some of Lidia's favorite comfort foods. The combination of potaoes and pasta in one dish is not unusual in Italy and in her Pippette with Sweet Potatoes, Lidia adds a beloved American ingredient to give it a nutritious and complex finish. Veal Stew with Onion and Squash is the perfect one-pot meal, in which the protein and vegetables come together.

programme.title: One Night Spouse
programme.desc: In the Big City, true love is increasingly hard to achieve. But what if brave souls, yearning for romance and a loving partnership, agree to a provocative proposal: getting married at first sight? This groundbreaking format offers a shockingly novel twist on the relationship, dating and wedding space. Four experts - a therapist, anthropologist, spiritualist and clinical psychologist - will create what they believe are three perfect couples. The twist is that these couples will never meet or know each other until they walk down the aisle and see each other face to face - for the first time - at the altar. Each self-contained episode will track classic lifestyle stories of newlyweds: the honeymoon; early nesting; meeting the in-laws; and other universally relatable events of married life. Will they remain together in the end, or decide to separate?

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: The American Navy got back on course after Pearl Harbour, and in the four-day Battle for the Coral Sea, they claimed victory, before defeating Japan again in the decisive Battle of Midway. Elsewhere the Luftwaffe targeted more British cities.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: Hitler's 'Desert Fox', Rommel advanced at El Alamein, but with the arrival of British General, Bernard Montgomery, to lead the Eighth Army in North Africa, the wind of change was about to blow.

programme.title: Sacrifice: From D-Day to the Liberation of Paris
programme.desc: June 5th, 1944: A monumental Allied force assembles to liberate Europe from Nazi rule. With tension high and WWII entering its fifth year, two million soldiers stand prepared for sacrifice. In France, civilians eagerly await their deliverance, listening to Radio-London. As Allies land in Normandy, civilians, oblivious to danger, emerge to welcome them amidst combat.

programme.title: Hitler and Churchill: The Eagle and the Lion
programme.desc: On one side is Winston Churchill, one of the most revered men of the century. His humor, style, self-deprecation and audacity in the face of adversity is still regarded as a prime example of leadership and political courage. On the other side is Adolf Hitler, the most hated leader in contemporary history. His regime and his ideas represent fear, xenophobia, racism, and a hatred for humanity.

programme.title: WWII: On the Edge of the Abyss
programme.desc: By 1942, the war has reached a global scale. This episode examines key battles in North Africa, the Pacific, and the Eastern Front, as well as the escalating human cost of the conflict. The tension builds as the Axis powers push forward, threatening to overwhelm their adversaries, and the world braces for what seems like an inevitable collapse.

programme.title: World of Warships Clash of Titans
programme.desc: On December 7, 1941, Japan attacked Pearl Harbor, aiming to destroy the U.S. fleet and control the Pacific. The U.S. retaliated at the Battle of Midway in 1942, sinking four Japanese carriers. Realizing air power's importance, the U.S. built 95 aircraft carriers in three years, key to victories in Tarawa, Guadalcanal, and Okinawa. The USS Midway, a large carrier, was a symbol of Pacific dominance.

programme.title: Africa Freed
programme.desc: The conquest of Tunisia was a triumph for the United Nations, who on land, sea and air, worked as one. This film, together with another made by American Allies, shows how victory was shaped and achieved. Africa Freed tells chiefly of the part played by British arms as recorded by our cameramen who marched alongside. It is a tribute to those fighting with allies in American and France.

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: The beginning of 1945 sees millions of troops assembled in central Europe; their respective journeys having brought them to the very borders of Germany itself. Eisenhower's expeditionary forces, Stalin's Red Army, and the remnants of Hitler's Wehrmacht, all bruised and battered from the winter campaigns, review their condition and steel themselves for the final chapters of World War 2.

programme.title: The History of Tanks
programme.desc: Documenting the changing face of tank warfare over the past 100 years, this fascinating documentary is not to be missed by those with an interest in military history and weapon development.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: The men of the 283rd Medical Attachment, providing air ambulance support in Vietnam.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Gulf War
programme.desc: In the early morning hours of the 17th of January 1991, coalition air forces unleashed a massive air assault on Iraqi forces in both Iraq and Kuwait. The magnitude of the coalition air offensive dealt a crushing blow to Iraq's air defense network.

programme.title: Iron Curtain - Life Under Soviet Occupation
programme.desc: 1944-45. As the Red Army pushes toward Berlin, Stalin seizes Eastern Europe, exploiting postwar chaos to impose communist regimes. Industries are requisitioned, propaganda expands, and dissent crushed through arrests. Marxism-Leninism becomes the only creed. By the late 1940s, the Iron Curtain has fallen, sealing millions under Soviet rule.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Paranormal investigators risk their own safety to protect others. Mary Vogel, a spiritual counselor, faces a force that shakes her faith. Nightmares consume her, unseen entities attack, and even church feels sinister. A voice whispers, 'Your God can't help you now.' Her mentor, John Zaffis, realizes the truth-Mary is possessed, and only an exorcism can save her soul.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Time slowly erases reminders of the past. Old roads are abandoned, and their destinations forgotten. When Clara's family moves to rural Hinsdale, NY, they expect peace but find eerie disturbances. Ritualistic chanting echoes from the woods, and neighbors whisper of roaming ghosts. A psychic warns that spirits are drawn to their home-and to a gruesome secret hidden in the crawlspace.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: It's said that every photograph steals a piece of a soul. What happens when the subject is dead? Lisa becomes obsessed with a photo of her boyfriend's brother, killed in Vietnam. As her fixation deepens, she experiences waking visions of the soldier and believes the picture has a life of its own. When her daughters report supernatural encounters, Lisa realizes the spirit is taking control.

programme.title: Gehlen: Hitler's Superspy
programme.desc: Reinhard Gehlen was Hitler's Chief of Intelligence on the Russian Front during WWII. Before May 1945 he had secreted himself and the files on the Soviets away from Berlin. He then bargained for his freedom with the advancing Americans and his files formed the basis of the CIA when it was set up in 1947. The story traces Gehlen's joining the Nazi party to his retirement on a CIA pension.

programme.title: Ark of The Covenant: New Evidence?
programme.desc: It is a quest that has fascinated scholars and adventurers for century after century. What happened to that treasure and centerpiece of ancient Jewish life - the Ark of the Covenant? No one knows what happened to it, but researchers never give up seeking for this which will no doubt rank among history's greatest finds if it is ever discovered.

programme.title: The Egyptian Mummies - Immortality Unwrapped
programme.desc: At Saqqara, the discovery of a hidden embalming workshop reveals recipes for mummification balms and evidence of vast trade networks reaching as far as Southeast Asia. Combining archaeology, science, and myth, researchers uncover how the Egyptians preserved flesh, protected the soul, and prepared for eternity.

programme.title: The Egyptians
programme.desc: The tomb of the last queen of Egypt has never been found, despite experts searching for centuries. While many historians believe it is located near a temple to Isis, East of ancient Alexandria, new discoveries indicate that it might be near Taposiris Magna. Through field excavations, 3D modeling and reenactments, this documentary series will retrace the life of Cleopatra.

programme.title: Life in Victorian Times
programme.desc: The Victorian era was one of the most remarkable in British history; it saw The Industrial Revolution, the growth of the major cities, the birth of the Empire and huge advances in medicine, transport and education. It was also a time when harsh working conditions and desperate poverty blighted the lives of the majority of the people of the country.

programme.title: The Auschwitz Museum
programme.desc: Here's the Auschwitz-Birkenau museum, as it appears to us: vestiges, ruins, traces. Some barbed wires, some barracks, some birches. A museum without any works of art, a cemetery without any graves, a Unesco listed site, yet without any trace of heritage. Thousands of visitors are coming here every day in numbers and from all around the world, without really knowing what they're looking for.

programme.title: Europe - History Seen From Above
programme.desc: In 1492, the marriage of Isabella of Castile and Ferdinand of Aragon united Spain, earning them the title of Catholic Monarchs. Their rule ended centuries of Reconquista with the fall of Granada, while Isabella financed Columbus' voyage that unveiled the New World. This discovery sparked Spain's golden age, fueling power, wealth, and influence for more than three centuries.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths: The Odyssey
programme.desc: Odysseus and his companions are trapped in the Cyclops' cave. But he is a man with a plan. He carves out a stake and, after having drunk Polyphemus under the table, drives it into his one eye.

programme.title: 444 Days: The Iran Hostage Crisis
programme.desc: It was a 444 days ordeal for the American diplomats taken hostage in Tehran. 444 days of humiliation for the most powerful nation in the world, the United States. In these 444 days, Iranian Islamists imposed their will on their country and the world. Rediscover the events of November 4, 1979 to January 20, 1981.

programme.title: Henry VIII: The Tyrant King and His Six Wives
programme.desc: Aside from being an unruly tyrant, Henry VIII is well known for his infamous riding accident. Tracy's research reveals the real story and how his ulcerated leg developed and was treated. Related topics explored are medicine and treatments in Tudor times, Henry VIII's fascination with astronomy and the cuisine in Henry's court.

programme.title: The Viking Myths
programme.desc: Odin, up on his observation throne, discovers the monstrous children Loki has fathered with the giantess: the wolf, the snake and the monstrous child. He sends his son Týr and the beautiful Freyja to bring them back to him. For his part, Thor decides to set off again on adventures in the land of the giants with Loki, and travels to the giants' fortress, Utgard.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Famosos de niños
programme.desc: Madres que vieron a sus hijos triunfar en el mundo del espectáculo cuentan sus historias, el éxito en la niñez donde se vuelven estrellas es un mundo en el que las madres ven a sus hijos como sus pequeños.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Cordero y Venado

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Fuga de El Chapo

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Misterio al final del túnel
programme.desc: El escándalo de la fuga de Joaquín Guzmán quien escapó de una celda de 3 x 2 metros y que logró burlar los sistemas de seguridad de la prisión del Altiplano.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - ¿Sabes lo que comes?
programme.desc: Los peligros que existen en los alimentos que consumimos día con día, los diferentes problemas de salud que podemos encontrar con una mala alimentación.Según los expertos, existen varias alternativas para llevar una vida sana.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Curvas y armas 'Las Buchonas'
programme.desc: Una vida llena de cirugías plásticas, lujos, excesos y armas; mujeres jóvenes y ambiciosas que están dispuestas a todo por tener una buena vida.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Mutilados
programme.desc: Personas con capacidades diferentes cuentan sus historias de lo que ha sido viajar a bordo de ‘La bestia’. Una esperanza de llegar a La Casa Blanca es lo que tienen ‘los mutilados’.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - 36 Horas
programme.desc: Una familia con una vida normal cambia de la noche a la mañana cuando el pequeño Oliver es diagnosticado con una agresiva enfermedad. Los padres de Oliver son notificados y comienza el calvario de 36 horas.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Recaptura de El Chapo
programme.desc: Teresa Rodríguez relata la historia de la recaptura de Joaquín Guzmán Loera 'El Chapo'. Desde el escape de 'El Chapo' junto con 'El Cholo' de la casa en Culiacán hasta la captura de ambos delincuentes en un hotel de paso.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Reencuentros
programme.desc: Hay veces que las familias son separadas por situaciones fortuitas. Alejandro Muñoz es un periodista cuyo propósito en su programa de televisión es reunir a familias separadas por diversos motivos. Él nos cuenta algunas de sus experiencias.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Cruzando al borde
programme.desc: La patrulla fronteriza de Estados Unidos tiene registro de que la mayoría de indocumentados que cruzan la frontera son centroamericanos. Dentro de esta población hay muchos menores de edad que viajan solos para reunirse con sus familiares.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Historias de Puebla York
programme.desc: En Nueva York existe una importante cantidad de población inmigrante proveniente de Casa Blanca, un pueblo del estado de Puebla en México. Ellos desean reunirse de nuevo con sus padres después de muchos años de no verlos.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Deportation INC
programme.desc: La inmigración a Estados Unidos se ha convertido en una industria con un enfoque monetario. En este episodio se dan a conocer las implicaciones monetarias además de los estragos emocionales que deja en los inmigrantes.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Ángeles y Demonios
programme.desc: Salmo 100 es una organización que lleva mensajes de paz y reconciliación. Las historias de Daniel, Adrián o Giovanni son ejemplos que usa Salmo 100 para ayudar a más personas que quieren salir del mundo del crimen organizado en la frontera.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Los Deportables
programme.desc: Las redadas que realizan los agentes de migración han hecho que el miedo tome muchos vecindarios de Estados Unidos. Las historias de quienes han sido deportados son contadas. También las historias de quienes viven temerosos de ser deportados.

programme.title: Virgen que forjó una patria

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 104
programme.desc: Giovanni se molesta al enterarse que Miguel fue a buscar a Mía. Roberta encuentra a Mía con Alma y se siente traicionada. Alma le dice a Madariaga que Mía está con ella. Miguel llega por Mía al remolque de Alma, se besan y deciden pasar el día juntos.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 105
programme.desc: Al regresar al colegio, Miguel le dice a Mía que no pueden ser novios y que deben olvidar lo que pasó entre ellos. José le confiesa a Roberta que ocupó su nombre para lograr que Teo fuera más seguro de sí mismo. Miguel termina con Julieta.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 106
programme.desc: Roberta, cegada por sus celos, le pide a Alma elegir entre Mía y ella. Miguel le dice a Giovanni que Mía no es para él. Miguel le confiesa a Mía lo que siente por ella, y acuerdan ocultar su relación para no lastimar a nadie.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 107
programme.desc: Franco piensa que Alma es quien pone a Mía en su contra. Mía no cree en su papá. Miguel no quiere seguir ocultando la relación con Mía. Celina le dice a Giovanni que Mía ya no quiere ser su novia. Augusto termina con Celina.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 108
programme.desc: Nico trata de que Miguel acepte que es novio de Mía. Miguel le pide a Mía enfrentar a Giovanni. Mía le confiesa a Giovanni que está enamorada de otro y termina con él. Franco no recuerda lo que hizo la noche anterior con Alma.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 109
programme.desc: Valeria advierte a Alma que se aleje de Franco. Madariaga le sugiere a Pascual acercarse a Pilar y apoyarla. Mía sale corriendo después de estar a solas con Miguel besándose. Mía se disculpa con Miguel y le dice que desea hacerse mujer con él.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 110
programme.desc: Pascual y Galia le demuestran a Pilar que les importa. Paula se enoja con Diego por encontrarlo en una situación comprometedora con otra. Vico y José siguen investigando. Diego le inventa a León que regresó con Roberta para no ir con él.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 111
programme.desc: Teo le cuenta a Miguel que pasó la prueba de la Logia, gracias a su novia Roberta. Franco habla con Mía sobre su mamá. Roberta se entera de que Diego inventó que son novios, sólo para estar con Paula. Pilar se realiza una prueba de embarazo.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 112
programme.desc: Franco le dice a Miguel que desde que Mía está enamorada es más madura. León se enfurece al darse cuenta de que Giovanni ocupó el lugar de Diego en el partido de Polo. Alma, Valeria y Carlo coinciden en el fin de semana de Mía, Miguel y Franco.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 113
programme.desc: Vico y José enfrentan a Esteban. Roberta le pone un ultimátum a Teo, que elija entre ella o la Logia. Alma tiene una discusión con Franco y lo avienta al mar por insinuar que es una mujer interesada. Diego es atrapado por los hombres de la Logia.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 114
programme.desc: Carlo queda encantado con Alma y la visita en el camerino. Diego ve a su mamá en el concierto de la banda, el cual es un éxito. Diego tiene una terrible discusión con Roberta y la insulta. Roberta intenta coquetear con Carlo en una cafetería.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 115
programme.desc: Giovanni trata de hacerle creer a Tomás que Luisa no es su madre, pues no quiere que descubra la verdad. Roberta se da cuenta que Alma está con Carlo y les estropea la reunión. Mía escucha la conversación de Miguel con su mamá y se va llorando.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica quiere sorprender a Aurelio con su embarazo, pero se lo encuentra en la cama con Victoria. Se hace pasar por su hermana y, a solas, jura no perdonarlo si él se enamora de otra.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victoria sube en las encuestas y eso preocupa a Elsa, quien, en un intento desesperado por ganar votantes, le propone a Max cerrar Villa Catalina. El Chema comienza a interesarse en Rutila.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Elsa visita a Victoria y le propone una tregua para trabajar juntas contra el narcotráfico. Max está dispuesto a perder el juicio de Ximena para demostrar con quién está su fidelidad.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema ordena la emboscada para recuperar al hijo de Matilde; cuando ella se arrepiente, ya es demasiado tarde. Mientras trata de escapar con sus nietos, doña Alba es brutalmente herida.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Doña Alba es sometida a una cirugía, ha perdido mucha sangre y se debate entre la vida y la muerte. Aurelio sospecha que Matilde y el Chema están detrás. Ximena es condenada a prisión.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio averigua quién es en verdad el escolta de Matilde, y le dice que se despida de su hijo. Los Casillas le declaran la guerra al Chema, y averiguan dónde se esconden sus hombres.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Matilde trata de reconciliarse con Chacorta, pero ya tiene los minutos contados: él no le perdona la traición. Lo importante ahora para los Casillas es hacer pagar al Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ximena se enfrenta en la cárcel a otras presas que la provocan, y se descubre que ella es la viuda del Señor de los Cielos. A petición de Rutila, Aurelio acepta reunirse con Santiago.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Luego de un enfrentamiento en el hospital, rodean a Leonor y Ramos, quienes tienen que dejar escapar a Heriberto. Para probar su lealtad al Chema, Ernesto mata a uno de los hombres de Chacorta.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema escapa de la cárcel con ayuda de Tijeras. Sin saberlo, Elsa firma los papeles que garantizan la fuga. Ella y Victoria siguen adelante con sus campañas por el Gobierno de Jalisco.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Heriberto y Leonor se enfrentan por última vez. Él descubre la emboscada, pero no puede escapar de su suerte. Moribundo, asegura que ella se ha convertido en lo que tanto combatió, una asesina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tras la muerte de Heriberto, Aurelio declara la guerra para vengarlo: tiene ganas de matar a medio mundo. Todos se preparan para lo peor. Victoria le pone más protección a Leonor.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio envía a Chacorta para ajustar cuentas con Leonor e Ignacio por la muerte de Heriberto: la orden es asesinarlos a todos. Ximena está desconsolada, y culpa a su exesposo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ignacio intenta interrogar al Manotas, pero la rabia se lo impide, y lo mata. Comienza a vengarse de todos los que participaron en la muerte de su padre. Victoria gana las elecciones.

As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Sisters
programme.desc: When their parents decide to sell their home, siblings Maura (Amy Poehler) and Kate (Tina Fey) learn that they have one weekend to clean out the junk from their old bedroom. Unhappy with the news, the recently divorced Maura and her hotheaded sister make plans to throw one final bash to recapture their glory days with their former classmates. As the raging party begins to spiral out of control, the gals soon realize that there may not be a house left once the dust settles.

programme.title: A Simple Favor
programme.desc: Stephanie is a widowed single mother who works as a vlogger in Connecticut. Her best friend, Emily, seems to have it all, a successful career, a loving family and a glamorous lifestyle. When Emily mysteriously disappears one day, Stephanie launches her own investigation by digging into her friend's past, finding a few surprises along the way.

programme.title: American Ultra
programme.desc: Small-town stoner Mike Howell (Jesse Eisenberg) spends most of his time getting high and writing a graphic novel. What Mike doesn't know is that he was trained by the CIA to be a lethal killing machine. When the agency targets him for termination, his former handler activates his latent skills, turning the mild-mannered slacker into a deadly weapon. Now, the utterly surprised Mike must use his newfound abilities to save himself and his girlfriend from getting smoked.

programme.title: The Unbearable Weight of Massive Talent
programme.desc: Unfulfilled and facing financial ruin, actor Nick Cage accepts a $1 million offer to attend a wealthy fan's birthday party. Things take a wildly unexpected turn when a CIA operative recruits Cage for an unusual mission. Taking on the role of a lifetime, he soon finds himself channeling his most iconic and beloved characters to save himself and his loved ones.

programme.title: The Hitman's Bodyguard
programme.desc: The world's top protection agent is called upon to guard the life of his mortal enemy, one of the world's most notorious hit men. The relentless bodyguard and manipulative assassin have been on the opposite end of the bullet for years and are thrown together for a wildly outrageous 24 hours. During their journey from England to The Hague, they encounter high-speed car chases, outlandish boat escapades and a merciless Eastern European dictator who is out for blood.

programme.title: The Hitman's Wife's Bodyguard
programme.desc: Bodyguard Michael Bryce and hitman Darius Kincaid are back for another life-threatening mission; still unlicensed and under scrutiny, Bryce is forced into action by Darius's even more volatile wife; soon, all three are in over their heads when a madman's sinister plot threatens to leave Europe in chaos.

programme.title: Long Shot
programme.desc: Fred Flarsky is a gifted and free-spirited journalist who has a knack for getting into trouble. Charlotte Field is one of the most influential women in the world -- a smart, sophisticated and accomplished politician. When Fred unexpectedly runs into Charlotte, he soon realizes that she was his former babysitter and childhood crush. When Charlotte decides to make a run for the presidency, she impulsively hires Fred as her speechwriter -- much to the dismay of her trusted advisers.

programme.title: The Lords of Salem
programme.desc: A radio DJ (Sheri Moon Zombie) in Salem, Mass., is plagued by nightmarish visions of vengeful witches after she plays a record by a mysterious group known only as "The Lords."

programme.title: House of 1000 Corpses
programme.desc: An empty fuel tank and a flat tire lead two couples down a terror-riddled road to the House of 1000 Corpses. House of 1000 Corpses is at its core a story of family - a cast of twisted individuals who, with each slash of a throat or stab through the chest, add bodies to their sick human menagerie.

programme.title: The Devil's Rejects
programme.desc: After a raid on the rural home of the psychopathic Firefly family, two members of the clan, Otis (Bill Moseley) and Baby (Sheri Moon Zombie), manage to flee the scene. Heading to a remote desert motel, the killers reunite with Baby's father, Capt. Spaulding (Sid Haig), who is equally demented and intent on maintaining their murder spree. While the trio continues to torment and kill various victims, the vengeful Sheriff Wydell (William Forsythe) slowly closes in on them.

programme.title: 3 From Hell
programme.desc: Crazed killers Baby Firefly, Captain Spaulding and Otis Driftwood unleash bloody mayhem after escaping from prison.

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: Nearly two decades after being committed to a mental institution for killing his stepfather and older sister, Michael Myers breaks out, intent on returning to the town of Haddonfield, Ill. He arrives in his hometown on Halloween with the indomitable purpose of hunting down his younger sister, Laurie. The only thing standing between Michael and a Halloween night of bloody carnage is psychologist Dr. Samuel Loomis.

programme.title: Halloween II
programme.desc: A year after narrowly escaping death at the hands of Michael Myers (Tyler Mane), Laurie Strode is at the breaking point, pushed to the edge by Dr. Loomis' (Malcolm McDowell) revelation that she's Michael's sister. Little does she know, the unstoppable killer is back in Haddonfield and, driven by visions of their dead mother (Sheri Moon Zombie), he is determined to bring about a bloody family reunion.

programme.desc: When Pastor Noble Jonez's carefully constructed image begins to unravel, his wife Trezjiir is forced to confront not only the trauma of her past but the deceit poisoning her present. As buried secrets resurface-ranging from infidelity, hidden paternity, abuse of power, and criminal ties-every lie brings them closer to destruction.

programme.title: Buried
programme.desc: After the murder of his fianc?e and her lover, Cameron escapes Atlanta under a new identity and loses the trail of the investigators. When he meets Lauren after settling in Florida, his cover begins to crack when a neighbor begins asking questions, and opening secrets that are supposed to be buried.

programme.title: My Plus Size Bachelorette

With her friends rallying around her, they encourage Symone to embrace her single status and embark on a journey of self-discovery and love.

programme.title: Just in Time for the Holidays
programme.desc: Lawyer and widowed father of three, Allen, struggles to piece his life back together, while managing both roles of being a parent. Allen will receive the help he so desperately needs just in time for the holidays.

programme.desc: Two worlds collide when a mama's boy prepares for marriage, but cannot shake his mother's grasp

programme.title: Deceitful Tendencies
programme.desc: Successful, happily-married Devin, stumbles upon "damsel in distress", Skyler, on his way to work one day. When Devin decides to stop and help her, he ends up getting more than he bargained for. He realizes much too late that she has him wrapped in her deceitful web of temptation. Devin must now fight to save himself from Skylar's ruthless grasp, before she destroys his entire life.

programme.desc: A comic tale of seven years of tax avoidance. Following the possibly real-life exploits of Josh Kornbluth, this comedy blends solo performance and scripted scenes to bring the subjective reality of the storyteller hilariously to life.

While Jack teaches Ben how to shoot, ride a horse and perform a successful heist, he's also being pursued by a posse of vigilantes. Finally seeing the writing on the wall, Lightning Jack wants to make one last score and retire, but a rival gang isn't making it easy.

programme.title: Our Tomorrow
programme.desc: Our Tomorrow" is a powerful drama set in Kenya, where the rapid acquisition of land by investors has left many without a home. The film follows the journey of Kim (David Ochiel) as he seeks justice for the murder of his father. With the help of his friends Dante (Kennedy Gitagia) and Ryan (Lad Mambili), they take on the powerful and ruthless land developer, Rose (Cynthia Bonareri). As the stakes get higher, the trio must navigate corrupt officials, dangerous thugs, and their own personal demons to uncover the truth and reclaim their land. "Our Tomorrow" will take you on an emotional journey as the characters fight for their rights and for a better future for themselves and their community. Will they succeed or will they become another statistic in the fight for land rights? "Our Tomorrow" is a story of hope, friendship and the determination to build a better future.

programme.desc: Ni Sisi portrays a typical Kenyan community: a harmonious muddle of tribes, intermarriages, and extended families who have lived and worked together all their lives. Then one day rumors begin to spread and suddenly mistrust takes hold. People are identified as belonging to a different tribe rather than by their identity as a person. With mistrust comes a sense of threat and fear, and old friends now turn on each other. In a matter of days, the bonds and alliances are severed just as it did in reality in 2008. They find themselves plunging into chaos, and it seems unstoppable and brutal. Is it possible to learn from old mistakes and has a once peaceful community another chance?

programme.title: Paroled at 50: The Sex Offender Loophole
